karmicLessons.1: Initiative and self-confidence: learning to decide for yourself and to lead.
karmicLessons.2: Patience and cooperation: being gentle and diplomatic with others.
karmicLessons.3: Self-expression: sharing thoughts and feelings openly and with joy.
karmicLessons.4: Order and effort: doing work in a planned, steady way, to the end.
karmicLessons.5: Adapting to change: not fearing freedom and novelty.
karmicLessons.6: Responsibility: taking on care and commitment for family and loved ones.
karmicLessons.7: Depth and faith: trusting your inner world, knowledge and intuition.
karmicLessons.8: Managing the material: a healthy relationship with money, power and authority.
karmicLessons.9: Compassion and a wide view: helping others selflessly.

subconscious.1: You may get flustered in unexpected situations; support and a plan give you strength.
subconscious.2: You may get flustered in unexpected situations; support and a plan give you strength.
subconscious.3: You may hesitate in hard moments; moving step by step keeps you steady.
subconscious.4: Practical and composed; in difficulty you find the way out through order.
subconscious.5: Flexible and adaptable; you get used to new situations quickly.
subconscious.6: Responsible; in difficulty you think of others too.
subconscious.7: Analytical; you first try to understand the problem.
subconscious.8: Self-confident; you take charge in tense situations.
subconscious.9: Versatile and calm; you can take a broad view of any situation.

balance.1: In hard moments rely on your own strength, but do not hesitate to ask for help.
balance.2: In hard moments diplomacy and patience restore your balance.
balance.3: In hard moments communication and humour ease the tension.
balance.4: In hard moments make a plan and move forward step by step.
balance.5: In hard moments stay flexible: resisting change wears you out.
balance.6: In hard moments caring for others calms you too.
balance.7: In hard moments stepping back to reflect alone brings clarity.
balance.8: In hard moments keep control, but avoid harshness.
balance.9: In hard moments take the wide view: letting go of personal hurt opens the way.

physical.name: Physical
physical.meaning: Body, movement and concrete work: you take in the world through experience.

mental.name: Mental
mental.meaning: Logic, analysis and ideas: you take in the world by thinking.

emotional.name: Emotional
emotional.meaning: Feeling, empathy and creativity: you take in the world with the heart.

intuitive.name: Intuitive
intuitive.meaning: Inner sense and inspiration: you take in the world through intuition.

psychomatrix.intro: Pythagoras square (psychomatrix): four “work numbers” are calculated from the digits of the birth date, then every digit of the date and of these numbers is counted in a 3×3 grid. Each cell is a quality; the more often its digit repeats, the stronger the quality.
psychomatrix.variant2000: For births from 2000 the 3rd number is the 1st + 19 (the common modern variant).

levels.0: Character is weakly expressed: you may be swayed by others; build self-confidence.
levels.1: A tendency to put yourself first: the lesson is to use your will for goals, not against people.
levels.2: Gentle, diplomatic character: you present yourself well but avoid confrontation.
levels.3: Balanced, steady character: you insist when needed and compromise when needed.
levels.4: Strong will and leadership: demanding and decisive, sometimes too hard.

levels.0: Low energy: you tire quickly; sleep, exercise and nature matter.
levels.1: Below-average energy: a lot of socialising can drain you; you need breaks.
levels.2: Enough energy: normal strength for an active life.
levels.3: Strong energy: you inspire others and give people strength.
levels.4: Very strong energy: channel it into movement, sport and creativity.

levels.0: Little interest in exact sciences: the humanities are closer to you.
levels.1: A liking for order and neatness, but no special interest in exact sciences.
levels.2: Good aptitude for learning, technology and exact fields.
levels.3: A strong analytical mind: talent for science, technology and research.
levels.4: Very strong scientific interest: you sometimes focus on ideas more than on people.

levels.0: The body needs care: routine, movement and attention matter.
levels.1: Average stamina: keeps well with a good routine.
levels.3: A very strong body: you handle physical load well.

levels.0: Weak intuition: you learn much through trial and error.
levels.1: Logic is there, but hasty decisions can lead to mistakes: think before deciding.
levels.2: Strong logic and intuition: you sense events in advance.
levels.3: Very strong intuition: you read people and situations deeply.
levels.4: Foresight: you sometimes feel events before they happen.

levels.0: Physical work is hard for you: mental and creative fields suit you better.
levels.1: Manual and physical work only when you want to: it can be learnt.
levels.2: Practical skill and diligence: suited to both physical and mental work.
levels.3: Hard-working: you love work and keep going.
levels.4: Very strong work drive: you cannot stay idle.

levels.0: Talent has to be developed through effort: success comes from work.
levels.1: A small talent and some luck: discover and develop it.
levels.2: Clear talent and luck: you can shine in one field.
levels.3: Great talent: a special gift in art, science or creative work.
levels.4: Very strong talent: directing it well matters especially.

levels.0: A weak sense of responsibility: learn to care for others.
levels.1: A sense of duty is there, but not always in front.
levels.2: Strong responsibility: care for parents and loved ones.
levels.3: Oriented to serving others: the spirit of a teacher, doctor or helper.
levels.4: A very strong sense of duty: do not forget yourself for others.

levels.2: Good memory and ability to learn.
levels.3: A strong mind: you understand and remember quickly.
levels.4: A very strong mind: deep analysis, sometimes impatience with others.

selfEsteem.name: Self-esteem (1-2-3)
selfEsteem.low: You underrate yourself; learn to see your successes.
selfEsteem.high: High self-esteem; you sometimes listen too little to others.

work.name: Material security (4-5-6)
work.low: Earning takes more effort and planning.
work.mid: You can provide for yourself materially.
work.high: Strong material skill: you know how to earn and organise.

talent.name: Talent (7-8-9)
talent.low: Talent has to be brought out through effort.
talent.high: Great talent: making use of it is your task.

purpose.name: Purpose (1-4-7)
purpose.low: Setting goals and sticking to them can be hard.
purpose.mid: You can move towards a goal.
purpose.high: Very goal-driven: you do not stop until you get there.

family.name: Family (2-5-8)
family.low: Family life may not be your main priority.
family.high: Family matters a great deal; you will do much for loved ones.

habits.name: Stability, habits (3-6-9)
habits.low: You like change; routine feels confining.
habits.mid: A balance between stability and change.
habits.high: Stability and traditions matter a lot to you.

spirit.name: Spirituality (1-5-9)
spirit.low: Spiritual questions are not in front yet.
spirit.mid: There is spiritual search and faith.
spirit.high: A strong spiritual direction and deep faith.

temperament.name: Temperament (3-5-7)
temperament.high: A passionate temperament and strong attraction.

13.origin: 13/4: in traditional numerology this debt is read as a scenario of avoiding work and living off the effort of others.
13.shows: It can show as unfinished work, a feeling that effort goes unrewarded, or everything being won with great effort. Persistence and discipline are asked of you.
13.lesson: To finish what you start, to move steadily in small steps and to see value in the work itself.

14.origin: 14/5: in traditional numerology this debt is read as a scenario of spending freedom on excess and dependence.
14.shows: It can show as tension between the urge for change and movement and the need for stability, excess in habits and a tendency to avoid commitment.
14.lesson: Measure and consistency: to join freedom with responsibility and to stay on the path you chose.

16.origin: 16/7: in traditional numerology this debt is read as a scenario of pride, ego or broken trust in relationships.
16.shows: It can show as the sudden collapse of what was built, illusions falling away and the need to rebuild. Sometimes this is the road to humility.
16.lesson: Humility, turning to your inner truth and building life on values rather than on ego.

19.origin: 19/1: in traditional numerology this debt is read as a scenario of using power and independence only for oneself.
19.shows: It can show as a tendency to do everything alone, difficulty in asking for help and tension between independence and loneliness.
19.lesson: To learn to ask for and accept help, to share power and to trust others.

personalYearReading.1: A year of new beginnings: the nine-year cycle starts again. Initiative, independence and new projects come forward; the steps you take now set the direction of the coming years.
personalYearReading.2: A year of cooperation and patience: partnership, relationships and diplomacy come forward. It is a time to prepare, listen and wait rather than hurry.
personalYearReading.3: A year of creativity and communication: self-expression, social contacts and joy are the theme. A good year for sharing your ideas and giving time to creative work.
personalYearReading.4: A year of building: work, discipline, foundations and order come forward. It asks for effort but suits building long-term stability.
personalYearReading.5: A year of change: movement, travel, freedom and the unexpected are the theme. Stay open to the new, but avoid hasty decisions.
personalYearReading.6: A year of responsibility and family: home, care, commitments and harmony in relationships come forward. A time to give your close ones attention and to restore balance.
personalYearReading.7: A year of inner search: analysis, learning, spirituality and solitude are the theme. A good year to look inward, go deeper and draw conclusions.
personalYearReading.8: A year of achievement and power: career, money, influence and results come forward. The fruit of earlier work arrives, and with it a call for responsibility and measure.
personalYearReading.9: A year of completion: the nine-year cycle comes to an end. A time to let go of the old, forgive, sum up and prepare for the next cycle.

dayMaster.name: Day Master
dayMaster.meaning: You yourself: the core of the character.

sevenKillings.name: Seven Killings (Qi Sha)
sevenKillings.meaning: pressure, courage, a test of leadership

soul.name: Life palace
soul.meaning: Personality, character, the main theme of life.

wealth.name: Wealth
wealth.meaning: How money is earned and spent.

surface.name: Travel
surface.meaning: Life away from home, travel, public image.

same.name: Same animal
same.meaning: You understand each other well, but you also share the same weak spots.

sixHarmony.name: Six Harmonies (Liu He)
sixHarmony.meaning: One of the best pairings: natural closeness and complementing each other.

threeHarmony.name: Three Harmonies (San He)
threeHarmony.meaning: Animals of the same trine: shared values and easy cooperation.

clash.name: Clash (Liu Chong)
clash.meaning: Opposite animals: strong attraction but frequent disagreement; it takes patience and compromise.

harm.name: Harm (Liu Hai)
harm.meaning: Hidden tension and misunderstandings are possible; open communication matters.

neutral.name: Neutral
neutral.meaning: No special classical link: the relationship depends on personal effort and other factors.

tenGod.friend: A year of peers and self-reliance. You lean on your own strength and cooperation with equals goes well, but money can be shared or spread thin.
tenGod.robWealth: A year of rivalry and boldness. Competition grows and spending or risk-taking tends to rise; keep finances and joint ventures clear.
tenGod.eatingGod: A year of creativity and enjoyment. Ideas come easily, you express yourself freely and life feels more relaxed.
tenGod.hurtingOfficer: A year of sharp talent and questioning. You are brilliant and outspoken, restless with rules and bosses; choose your words with people in authority.
tenGod.indirectWealth: A year of active money and opportunity. Trade, side income and contacts move; gains come through initiative.
tenGod.directWealth: A year of steady income and order. Salary, savings and practical commitments stand out; relationships tend to settle.
tenGod.sevenKillings: A year of pressure and challenge. Demands and competition push you to act decisively; strong discipline turns it into achievement.
tenGod.directOfficer: A year of duty and recognition. Rules, responsibilities and career position come forward; a good time to earn trust.
tenGod.indirectResource: A year of unusual learning. Study, intuition and unconventional ideas or mentors; support arrives in unexpected ways.
tenGod.directResource: A year of support and learning. Teachers, protection, study and rest; a good year to build knowledge and credentials.

year.same: Your own animal year: traditionally a time of renewal and larger changes in public life; take extra care and avoid rash moves.
year.sixHarmony: Six harmony with your birth branch: support from family and the wider circle, and an easier public image.
year.threeHarmony: The same trine as your birth animal: shared values and easy cooperation with people around you.
year.clash: A clash with your birth animal (Tai Sui clash): traditionally a year of movement and disruption in public life, family or place; flexibility helps.
year.harm: Harm to your birth animal: small frictions with relatives or the wider circle; be tactful.

month.same: It repeats your career branch: work themes return and intensify.
month.sixHarmony: It combines with your career branch: supportive colleagues and a smoother working environment.
month.threeHarmony: It forms a trine with your career branch: teamwork and shared goals come easily.
month.clash: It clashes with your career branch: change at work, a move or a new role is likely; stay flexible.
month.harm: It harms your career branch: quiet friction at work or with a parent; avoid hidden resentment.

day.same: It repeats your day branch: personal and relationship themes return and intensify; self-awareness matters.
day.sixHarmony: It combines with your spouse palace: closeness and a favourable year for partnership.
day.threeHarmony: It forms a trine with your spouse palace: ease and shared aims in close relationships.
day.clash: It clashes with your spouse palace: tension or change in close relationships and your own routine; be patient.
day.harm: It harms your spouse palace: small misunderstandings with a partner; speak openly.

hour.same: It repeats your hour branch: plans, children and long-term themes return and intensify.
hour.sixHarmony: It combines with your hour branch: helpful for plans, children and long-term projects.
hour.threeHarmony: It forms a trine with your hour branch: long-term aims and creative work flow.
hour.clash: It clashes with your hour branch: plans, children or later-life matters may change course.
hour.harm: It harms your hour branch: small worries around plans or children.

sun.aries: Your core is a pioneer's: you come alive when there is something to start, win or defend. Directness is your honesty; patience is your lesson.
sun.taurus: You are built for steadiness: you grow by creating things that last and by enjoying what is real and tangible. Change comes slowly, but what you commit to, you keep.
sun.gemini: Your vitality comes from curiosity: ideas, conversations and connections keep you awake. You learn by asking, and you are at your best when you can explain what you have learned.
sun.cancer: At your core is the instinct to protect and nourish: home, family and emotional safety give you strength. Your sensitivity is a resource, not a weakness.
sun.leo: You shine by expressing yourself: creativity, generosity and warmth are your natural language. You need to be seen, and when you are, you light up the people around you.
sun.virgo: Your strength lies in refinement: you see what can be improved and quietly make it better. Being useful gives you meaning; the lesson is to be as kind to yourself as you are precise.
sun.libra: You come alive in relationship: balance, beauty and fairness are what you instinctively seek. You see every side of a question, which makes you a natural mediator and sometimes a slow decider.
sun.scorpio: Your core is intense and private: you want depth, truth and real transformation, not surface. You are loyal and perceptive, and you rebuild yourself after every crisis.
sun.sagittarius: You are driven by meaning and horizons: travel, learning and big questions feed your spirit. Optimism is your gift; following through is the skill to develop.
sun.capricorn: You are built for long goals: discipline, responsibility and a steady climb define you. You often mature early, and your achievements grow with time.
sun.aquarius: Your core is independent and forward-looking: you think in systems, groups and future possibilities. You value freedom and authenticity, even when they set you apart.
sun.pisces: You are imaginative and deeply empathetic: you sense what others feel and draw on a rich inner world. Art, compassion and spirituality are natural outlets; clear boundaries keep you strong.

moon.aries: Emotionally you react fast and honestly: feelings flare up and pass quickly. You feel safe when you can act, and you need room to let off steam.
moon.taurus: You need calm, comfort and predictability to feel secure. Good food, nature and touch soothe you, and your moods are steady and enduring.
moon.gemini: You process feelings by talking and thinking them through. Variety and conversation keep you emotionally balanced; boredom unsettles you more than conflict.
moon.cancer: Your emotional world is deep and protective: you remember feelings for a long time and care for people instinctively. Home and close bonds are your emotional anchor.
moon.leo: You need warmth, appreciation and a little drama in your emotional life. When you feel loved and noticed, you give generously and loyally.
moon.virgo: You calm down by putting things in order: routines, practical help and solving small problems soothe you. Worry is your stress signal; usefulness is your comfort.
moon.libra: Emotional harmony matters a lot to you: tension in relationships unsettles you quickly. You feel best in pleasant surroundings, with a partner or close friend to share things with.
moon.scorpio: Your feelings run deep and you rarely show all of them. You need trust and emotional honesty; once betrayed, you find it hard to forget.
moon.sagittarius: You need freedom and something to look forward to: plans, trips and new ideas lift your mood. You bounce back quickly and prefer optimism to brooding.
moon.capricorn: You keep your feelings under control and feel safest when life is structured. You show love through responsibility and practical support rather than words.
moon.aquarius: You need emotional space and like to understand your feelings from a little distance. Friendship and shared ideals mean a lot to you, and you dislike emotional pressure.
moon.pisces: You are emotionally porous: you absorb the moods of the people and places around you. Quiet, music, water and creative time restore you; you need time alone to recharge.

asc.aries: People see you as direct, energetic and quick to act. You meet new situations head-on, and the first impression you make is bold.
asc.taurus: You come across as calm, grounded and pleasant to be around. You approach new things carefully and prefer to take your time.
asc.gemini: You come across as lively, curious and talkative. You meet the world with questions and adapt quickly to new people.
asc.cancer: At first you come across as gentle, caring and somewhat reserved. You feel out a situation before opening up, and people sense they can trust you.
asc.leo: You have a noticeable presence: warm, confident and expressive. People remember you, and you naturally take centre stage.
asc.virgo: You come across as modest, attentive and composed. You notice details and approach life practically and thoughtfully.
asc.libra: You come across as charming, polite and easy to talk to. You approach people diplomatically and care about appearance and atmosphere.
asc.scorpio: You come across as intense, perceptive and hard to read. You observe before revealing yourself, and people sense your depth.
asc.sagittarius: You come across as open, friendly and full of enthusiasm. You approach life as an adventure and put people at ease with your humour.
asc.capricorn: You come across as serious, reliable and self-possessed. You approach new situations with caution and a clear sense of purpose.
asc.aquarius: You come across as original, friendly and a little unconventional. You treat people as equals and stand out without trying.
asc.pisces: You come across as soft, dreamy and sensitive. You take in the atmosphere around you, and people find it easy to open up to you.

mercury.aries: You think fast and speak your mind: quick decisions, short sentences, little patience for long explanations.
mercury.taurus: You think slowly and thoroughly: once you reach a conclusion, it is hard to change your mind. You learn best through practice and the senses.
mercury.gemini: Your mind is quick, versatile and curious about everything. You connect ideas easily, enjoy wordplay and can hold several threads at once.
mercury.cancer: You think through feeling and memory: you remember how something felt better than the facts. Your words are caring, and you choose them with emotional tact.
mercury.leo: You speak with confidence and warmth, and you like your ideas to be heard. You are a natural storyteller and persuade with enthusiasm.
mercury.virgo: Your mind is analytical and precise: you notice details, errors and how things can work better. You think best with lists, plans and clear facts.
mercury.libra: You think by weighing both sides and speak diplomatically. You are good at negotiation and finding the fair middle, though decisions can take time.
mercury.scorpio: Your mind is probing and perceptive: you look for what is hidden and are not satisfied with surface answers. You keep secrets well and speak with intensity.
mercury.sagittarius: You think in big pictures and are drawn to philosophy, travel and ideas about meaning. You speak frankly, sometimes too frankly, and teach naturally.
mercury.capricorn: Your thinking is practical, structured and goal-oriented. You speak carefully, value expertise and prefer plans that actually work.
mercury.aquarius: Your mind is original and independent: you question rules and enjoy unusual ideas, technology and systems. You think best when you are free to disagree.
mercury.pisces: You think in images, impressions and intuition rather than straight lines. You understand people without words and express yourself well through art, music or metaphor.

venus.aries: In love you are direct and passionate: you like the chase, quick sparks and honesty. Boredom cools you faster than conflict.
venus.taurus: You love steadily and sensually: comfort, beauty, touch and loyalty matter most. You show affection through care, gifts and time spent together.
venus.gemini: You fall for minds: conversation, humour and variety keep your interest. You need a partner who is also a friend you can talk to about everything.
venus.cancer: You love protectively and tenderly: emotional safety and closeness come first. You show love by caring for people and making them feel at home.
venus.leo: You love generously and openly, with romance and grand gestures. You want to admire your partner and to be admired in return.
venus.virgo: You show love through attention and practical help. You notice small needs, value reliability and prefer quiet devotion to big words.
venus.libra: Love and partnership are central to you: you seek harmony, fairness and beauty in relationships. You are charming and attentive, and you dislike open conflict.
venus.scorpio: You love intensely and all the way: you want depth, loyalty and complete honesty. Superficial relationships do not interest you; trust is earned slowly.
venus.sagittarius: You love freely and adventurously: shared journeys, laughter and growth matter more than routine. You need a partner who gives you room to explore.
venus.capricorn: You take love seriously: commitment, reliability and shared goals matter to you. You may open up slowly, but your loyalty lasts.
venus.aquarius: You love as a friend first: you need independence, honesty and a meeting of minds. Unusual relationships do not scare you; possessiveness does.
venus.pisces: You love romantically and selflessly: you idealise the people you love and sense their feelings deeply. Clear boundaries help keep your generosity healthy.

mars.aries: Your drive is direct, fast and competitive. You act first and think later, start things with great energy and need physical outlets.
mars.taurus: You act slowly but with great endurance: once you set a course, you do not give up. You are hard to provoke and hard to stop.
mars.gemini: Your energy goes into words and ideas: you argue well, multitask and get restless without variety. You fight with wit rather than force.
mars.cancer: You act to protect what you love. Your anger tends to be indirect or emotional, and you are strongest when defending family or home.
mars.leo: You act with pride, courage and flair. You want your efforts to be seen and you lead naturally, especially in creative or competitive settings.
mars.virgo: Your energy is precise and methodical: you work hard, improve things step by step and like a job done properly. Stress can turn into over-criticism.
mars.libra: You act through cooperation and diplomacy and prefer to avoid open confrontation. You fight hardest for fairness, for yourself and for others.
mars.scorpio: Your drive is intense, focused and strategic. You do not give up easily, work well under pressure and can channel great willpower toward a goal.
mars.sagittarius: You act with enthusiasm and optimism, especially for causes and adventures you believe in. You need freedom of movement; routine drains you.
mars.capricorn: Your drive is disciplined and ambitious: you set long-term goals and climb steadily. You control your energy well and get things done.
mars.aquarius: You act independently and for ideals: you fight for change, groups and causes larger than yourself. You resist being told what to do.
mars.pisces: Your energy flows rather than pushes: you act on intuition and inspiration, often for others. You avoid direct conflict and work best when you believe in the purpose.

jupiter.aries: Growth comes through courage and initiative: you are lucky when you take the first step and lead.
jupiter.taurus: Growth comes through patience and building resources: you prosper by steady work, good taste and enjoying life's comforts.
jupiter.gemini: Growth comes through learning, communication and connections: many interests and contacts bring you opportunities.
jupiter.cancer: Growth comes through caring, family and emotional generosity: you feel most abundant when you nurture others.
jupiter.leo: Growth comes through creativity and generous self-expression: your warmth and confidence open doors.
jupiter.virgo: Growth comes through useful work, skill and service: you prosper by improving things and helping in practical ways.
jupiter.libra: Growth comes through partnerships, fairness and diplomacy: good relationships bring you luck.
jupiter.scorpio: Growth comes through depth, research and transformation: you gain by facing what others avoid and by sharing resources.
jupiter.sagittarius: Growth comes naturally through travel, study and faith: broad horizons and optimism bring you opportunities.
jupiter.capricorn: Growth comes through discipline and responsibility: success arrives slowly but lasts, and it grows with experience.
jupiter.aquarius: Growth comes through ideas, communities and innovation: you benefit by thinking ahead and working with like-minded people.
jupiter.pisces: Growth comes through compassion, imagination and spiritual life: generosity and faith bring their own rewards.

saturn.aries: Your life lesson involves self-assertion: learning to act with patience and to lead without fear or impulsiveness.
saturn.taurus: Your life lesson involves security and self-worth: building lasting resources without fear of loss.
saturn.gemini: Your life lesson involves communication and learning: trusting your mind and speaking with clarity and depth.
saturn.cancer: Your life lesson involves emotional security and family: learning to care for yourself and to set healthy boundaries.
saturn.leo: Your life lesson involves self-expression: learning to shine and create without needing outside approval.
saturn.virgo: Your life lesson involves work and health: building good routines without sliding into perfectionism.
saturn.libra: Your life lesson involves relationships: learning commitment, fairness and balance between giving and receiving.
saturn.scorpio: Your life lesson involves trust and control: learning to share power, intimacy and resources without fear.
saturn.sagittarius: Your life lesson involves beliefs and meaning: building a personal philosophy grounded in experience, not dogma.
saturn.capricorn: Saturn is strong here: you have natural discipline and authority, and the lesson is to balance ambition with warmth.
saturn.aquarius: Your life lesson involves individuality within the group: building structures that serve people while staying yourself.
saturn.pisces: Your life lesson involves faith and boundaries: giving form to dreams and compassion without losing yourself.

uranus.aries: Generational: your generation breaks new ground through bold, individual action and pioneering independence.
uranus.taurus: Generational: your generation changes how people relate to money, resources, food and the material world.
uranus.gemini: Generational: your generation revolutionises communication, information and the way people learn and connect.
uranus.cancer: Generational: your generation reinvents the idea of home, family and emotional belonging.
uranus.leo: Generational: your generation seeks freedom in self-expression, creativity and personal style.
uranus.virgo: Generational: your generation brings change to work, health, technology and daily routines.
uranus.libra: Generational: your generation redefines partnership, marriage and equality in relationships.
uranus.scorpio: Generational: your generation breaks taboos around intimacy, power, money and transformation.
uranus.sagittarius: Generational: your generation questions beliefs and opens new horizons in travel, education and worldview.
uranus.capricorn: Generational: your generation reshapes institutions, careers and structures of authority.
uranus.aquarius: Generational: your generation is drawn to networks, technology, social ideals and collective change.
uranus.pisces: Generational: your generation seeks freedom through imagination, spirituality and dissolving old boundaries.

neptune.aries: Generational: your generation dreams of heroic action and idealises courage and new beginnings.
neptune.taurus: Generational: your generation idealises nature, beauty and material security.
neptune.gemini: Generational: your generation dreams through words, stories and new forms of communication.
neptune.cancer: Generational: your generation idealises home, homeland and family belonging.
neptune.leo: Generational: your generation romanticises love, glamour and creative self-expression.
neptune.virgo: Generational: your generation finds ideals in service, health and useful work.
neptune.libra: Generational: your generation idealises love, harmony and peace between people.
neptune.scorpio: Generational: your generation is drawn to the hidden, the psychological and the mystical.
neptune.sagittarius: Generational: your generation seeks spiritual truth through travel, philosophy and faith.
neptune.capricorn: Generational: your generation dissolves and reimagines old structures, authority and tradition.
neptune.aquarius: Generational: your generation dreams of a connected humanity, technology and collective ideals.
neptune.pisces: Generational: Neptune is at home here; your generation is highly sensitive, imaginative and spiritually open.

pluto.aries: Generational: your generation transforms the world through bold individual will and new beginnings.
pluto.taurus: Generational: your generation transforms values, resources and the relationship with the earth.
pluto.gemini: Generational: your generation transforms information, media and the power of ideas.
pluto.cancer: Generational: your generation lives through deep changes in family, home and homeland.
pluto.leo: Generational: your generation transforms self-expression, leadership and the role of the individual.
pluto.virgo: Generational: your generation transforms work, health, technology and everyday life.
pluto.libra: Generational: your generation transforms relationships, marriage and ideas of justice.
pluto.scorpio: Generational: Pluto is strong here; your generation faces taboos, power and transformation head-on.
pluto.sagittarius: Generational: your generation transforms beliefs, education and global connections.
pluto.capricorn: Generational: your generation transforms institutions, governments and economic structures.
pluto.aquarius: Generational: your generation transforms society through technology, networks and collective power.
pluto.pisces: Generational: your generation transforms spirituality, art and the boundaries between people.

sun.1: Your identity is on display: you are noticed easily, and life asks you to lead with your own personality.
sun.2: You build self-esteem by earning, owning and developing your talents; financial independence matters to you.
sun.3: You shine through words, learning and everyday contacts; writing, teaching or siblings can play a big role.
sun.4: Home, family and roots are central to who you are; you often come into your own in the second half of life.
sun.5: You come alive through creativity, romance, play and children; self-expression is a need, not a luxury.
sun.6: You find meaning in useful work, skill and daily routines; health and service are important themes.
sun.7: You discover yourself through partners and close relationships; cooperation brings out your best.
sun.8: You are drawn to depth: shared resources, intimacy, psychology and transformation shape your life.
sun.9: You grow through travel, study and big ideas; a personal philosophy gives your life direction.
sun.10: Career and public role are central: you want to achieve something visible and be recognised for it.
sun.11: You shine in groups, friendships and shared causes; your hopes for the future drive you.
sun.12: Your light works best behind the scenes: solitude, inner life, spirituality and quietly helping others matter to you.

moon.1: Your feelings show on your face; you are responsive and sensitive, and your moods affect how you come across.
moon.2: Emotional security is tied to material security; saving and having your own resources calms you.
moon.3: You need to talk about your feelings; close contact with siblings, neighbours and your local area matters.
moon.4: This is the Moon's natural house: family, home and a private refuge are deeply important to your well-being.
moon.5: You find emotional fulfilment in creativity, romance, play and children.
moon.6: Your mood is linked to routines, work and health; a well-ordered day keeps you balanced.
moon.7: You need emotional partnership; you feel secure when you have someone close to share life with.
moon.8: Your emotions are intense and private; deep bonds and trust are essential to you.
moon.9: You feel at home in the wider world: travel, learning and faith nourish you emotionally.
moon.10: Your feelings are tied to your public life; you may work with people, in care or with the public.
moon.11: Friends and community are your emotional support; you feel safe among like-minded people.
moon.12: You need time alone to process feelings; your inner world is rich and often hidden from others.

mercury.1: You come across as quick, talkative and curious; your mind is a central part of your personality.
mercury.2: You think a lot about money and value; you can earn through words, trade or ideas.
mercury.3: This is Mercury's natural house: learning, writing, talking and short trips fill your daily life.
mercury.4: Your thinking is shaped by home and family; you may work from home or talk things over a lot within the family.
mercury.5: You think creatively and playfully; you enjoy games, stories and creative writing.
mercury.6: Your mind is practical and detail-oriented; you think best about work, health and improving things.
mercury.7: You think best in dialogue; partners, clients and negotiations stimulate your mind.
mercury.8: Your mind goes deep: research, psychology, secrets and investigation attract you.
mercury.9: You are drawn to higher learning, languages, travel and big ideas.
mercury.10: Communication plays a key role in your career; you may be known for your ideas or your words.
mercury.11: You exchange ideas in groups and networks; friends stimulate your thinking.
mercury.12: Much of your thinking happens inwardly; intuition, reflection and quiet study suit you.

venus.1: You come across as charming and pleasant; appearance and style matter to you.
venus.2: You value comfort and beautiful things and can earn through art, beauty or good taste.
venus.3: You speak kindly and diplomatically; relationships with siblings and neighbours tend to be warm.
venus.4: A beautiful, harmonious home is important to you; family life brings you pleasure.
venus.5: Romance, pleasure, art and creativity bring you joy; love affairs play a big role.
venus.6: You enjoy a pleasant workplace and good relations with colleagues; your work may involve beauty or care.
venus.7: Partnership is central for you; you seek harmony in marriage and close relationships.
venus.8: Love is deep and intense for you; shared finances and intimacy are important themes.
venus.9: You love travel, foreign cultures and learning; love may come from afar.
venus.10: Charm helps your career; work in art, beauty, diplomacy or with people suits you.
venus.11: You enjoy friendship and social life; friends can become partners.
venus.12: Your love is private and selfless; you may have secret feelings or a strongly compassionate side.

mars.1: You come across as energetic, direct and assertive; you act quickly.
mars.2: You work hard to earn and defend your resources; you can be impulsive with money.
mars.3: You speak sharply and debate eagerly; your mind is quick and competitive.
mars.4: Your energy goes into home and family; there may be tension at home, or you work hard on it.
mars.5: You are passionate in love, sport and creative pursuits; competition energises you.
mars.6: You work energetically and hard; exercise is important for your health.
mars.7: Relationships are dynamic and sometimes combative; you may attract strong-willed partners.
mars.8: You have great willpower and intensity; shared resources and power can become areas of struggle.
mars.9: You fight for your beliefs and love adventure, sport and travel.
mars.10: You are ambitious and driven in your career; you want to lead and achieve.
mars.11: You put energy into groups and causes; you can be a leader among friends.
mars.12: Your drive works behind the scenes; anger can stay hidden, so healthy outlets matter.

jupiter.1: You come across as optimistic, generous and confident; luck often follows personal initiative.
jupiter.2: There is good potential for income and resources; generosity with money comes naturally.
jupiter.3: Learning, writing and communication bring opportunities; you have a broad mind.
jupiter.4: A spacious home and a supportive family are blessings; life tends to improve over time.
jupiter.5: Joy, creativity, romance and children bring growth and good fortune.
jupiter.6: Work and service bring growth; you enjoy helping and usually find good work.
jupiter.7: Partnerships bring luck and growth; you may meet generous or wise partners.
jupiter.8: You can benefit from shared resources, inheritance or investment, and from deep inner work.
jupiter.9: This is Jupiter's natural house: travel, study, teaching and faith bring great opportunities.
jupiter.10: There are good prospects for career success and public recognition.
jupiter.11: Friends, networks and groups bring opportunities; your hopes tend to grow and come true.
jupiter.12: Hidden protection: faith, compassion and inner life support you in difficult times.

saturn.1: You come across as serious and responsible; confidence grows with age and experience.
saturn.2: Money comes through steady effort; the lesson is to build security without fear of scarcity.
saturn.3: You think carefully and take learning seriously; the lesson is to trust your own voice.
saturn.4: Home and family carry responsibility; you build your own stable base step by step.
saturn.5: Joy and self-expression may need to be learned; creativity matures with discipline.
saturn.6: You are a dedicated, reliable worker; your health benefits from steady routines.
saturn.7: You take relationships seriously; commitment may come later but tends to last.
saturn.8: Trust and intimacy take time; you learn to handle shared resources responsibly.
saturn.9: You build your worldview carefully; serious study and structured learning suit you.
saturn.10: This is Saturn's natural house: career success comes through hard work and grows over time.
saturn.11: You value a few loyal friends; taking responsibility within groups comes naturally.
saturn.12: Hidden fears or responsibilities work in the background; solitude and reflection help you.

uranus.1: You come across as original and independent; change and freedom are part of your identity.
uranus.2: Income may be irregular or unconventional; technology or new ideas can bring money.
uranus.3: Your thinking is original and fast; you may have unusual ideas or ways of communicating.
uranus.4: Home life may be unusual or change often; you need freedom even in your own home.
uranus.5: Your creativity and love life are unconventional; sudden romances are possible.
uranus.6: You need freedom at work; flexible or technology-related jobs suit you.
uranus.7: You need freedom in relationships; partners may be unusual, or relationships may change suddenly.
uranus.8: Sudden changes in shared resources or deep psychological breakthroughs are possible.
uranus.9: Your beliefs are independent; unusual philosophies, travel and new knowledge attract you.
uranus.10: Your career may take unexpected turns; you need independence and innovation in your work.
uranus.11: This is Uranus's natural house: unusual friends, networks and progressive ideals are important.
uranus.12: Sudden insights come from the unconscious; your independence may be hidden or inward.

neptune.1: You come across as gentle, dreamy or hard to define; you absorb your surroundings easily.
neptune.2: Money and values can be idealistic or unclear; financial clarity needs attention.
neptune.3: Your thinking is imaginative and intuitive; you communicate well through images and stories.
neptune.4: Home may be idealised or unclear; you long for a peaceful, almost sacred refuge.
neptune.5: Your creativity is inspired and romantic; art, music or theatre can be a gift.
neptune.6: You want to serve and help; care, healing or the arts suit you, but routines need attention.
neptune.7: You may idealise partners; seeing them as they are is the lesson in relationships.
neptune.8: You are drawn to the mystical and the hidden; boundaries in intimacy and shared money matter.
neptune.9: You have a spiritual, idealistic worldview; travel and philosophy inspire you.
neptune.10: Your career may be connected with art, care or ideals; your public image can be glamorous or vague.
neptune.11: You have idealistic hopes and gentle friendships; choose friends with clear eyes.
neptune.12: This is Neptune's natural house: a rich inner world, intuition and spiritual sensitivity.

pluto.1: You have a powerful, intense presence; you transform yourself several times in life.
pluto.2: Resources and self-worth go through deep transformations; you can build wealth, lose it and rebuild it.
pluto.3: Your mind is penetrating and persuasive; words carry power for you.
pluto.4: Deep family dynamics shape you; home can be a place of transformation.
pluto.5: Love and creativity are intense and transformative; you put your whole self into them.
pluto.6: You can transform work and health habits deeply; you are a powerful, thorough worker.
pluto.7: Relationships are intense and transformative; power dynamics with partners need awareness.
pluto.8: This is Pluto's natural house: deep psychology, intimacy and transformation are central themes.
pluto.9: Your beliefs go through deep transformations; you look for the truth behind ideas.
pluto.10: You seek power and influence in your career; your public life may change radically.
pluto.11: You can influence groups and society; friendships may transform you.
pluto.12: Deep forces work in your unconscious; inner work and solitude bring powerful healing.

aspectPairs.sun-moon: Links your will and your emotional needs: how well what you want and what you need work together.
aspectPairs.sun-mercury: Your identity and your mind are closely joined: you think and speak from who you are.
aspectPairs.sun-venus: Links identity with love, charm and pleasure: how you express affection and enjoy life.
aspectPairs.sun-mars: Links identity with drive and will: how you assert yourself and use your energy.
aspectPairs.sun-jupiter: Links identity with growth and optimism: your confidence, generosity and eye for opportunity.
aspectPairs.sun-saturn: Links identity with responsibility and limits: discipline, self-doubt and the slow building of authority.
aspectPairs.sun-uranus: Links identity with freedom and change: your need to be original and independent.
aspectPairs.sun-neptune: Links identity with imagination and ideals: inspiration, sensitivity and at times an unclear sense of self.
aspectPairs.sun-pluto: Links identity with power and transformation: intensity, willpower and deep personal change.
aspectPairs.moon-mercury: Links feelings and thoughts: how easily you put emotions into words.
aspectPairs.moon-venus: Links emotional needs with love and pleasure: tenderness, comfort and how you give and receive affection.
aspectPairs.moon-mars: Links feelings with action: emotional reactions, temper and the courage to protect what you care about.
aspectPairs.moon-jupiter: Links feelings with generosity and optimism: emotional warmth, faith and a big heart.
aspectPairs.moon-saturn: Links feelings with control and duty: emotional restraint, a need for security and maturity.
aspectPairs.moon-uranus: Links feelings with freedom: sudden mood changes and a need for emotional independence.
aspectPairs.moon-neptune: Links feelings with imagination and empathy: deep sensitivity, intuition and a dreamy emotional life.
aspectPairs.moon-pluto: Links feelings with intensity and transformation: deep emotions, strong attachments and emotional power.
aspectPairs.mercury-venus: Links mind with charm: a pleasant way with words, diplomacy and artistic thinking.
aspectPairs.mercury-mars: Links mind with drive: quick, sharp thinking, debate and decisive speech.
aspectPairs.mercury-jupiter: Links mind with breadth: big-picture thinking, learning and optimism in ideas.
aspectPairs.mercury-saturn: Links mind with structure: careful, serious, disciplined thinking.
aspectPairs.mercury-uranus: Links mind with originality: flashes of insight, inventive ideas and quick, unusual thinking.
aspectPairs.mercury-neptune: Links mind with imagination: intuitive, poetic thinking, and sometimes vagueness.
aspectPairs.mercury-pluto: Links mind with depth: penetrating, investigative thinking and persuasive words.
aspectPairs.venus-mars: Links love with desire: attraction, passion and the balance between giving and taking.
aspectPairs.venus-jupiter: Links love with abundance: generosity, warmth, pleasure and sometimes excess.
aspectPairs.venus-saturn: Links love with commitment: loyalty, seriousness in relationships and fear of rejection.
aspectPairs.venus-uranus: Links love with freedom: sudden attractions, unconventional relationships and a need for space.
aspectPairs.venus-neptune: Links love with ideals: romance, compassion, artistic sensitivity and a tendency to idealise.
aspectPairs.venus-pluto: Links love with intensity: deep, transformative attraction and strong emotional bonds.
aspectPairs.mars-jupiter: Links drive with growth: enthusiasm, ambition and energy for big goals.
aspectPairs.mars-saturn: Links drive with discipline: endurance, controlled effort and sometimes frustration.
aspectPairs.mars-uranus: Links drive with freedom: sudden action, independence and restless energy.
aspectPairs.mars-neptune: Links drive with ideals: acting on inspiration or for others, sometimes with unclear goals.
aspectPairs.mars-pluto: Links drive with power: enormous willpower, intensity and the ability to push through almost anything.
aspectPairs.jupiter-saturn: Links growth with structure: the balance between expansion and caution on your life path.
aspectPairs.jupiter-uranus: Links growth with innovation: sudden opportunities, breakthroughs and a love of freedom.
aspectPairs.jupiter-neptune: Links growth with ideals: spirituality, compassion, big dreams and faith.
aspectPairs.jupiter-pluto: Links growth with power: ambition, influence and the drive for large-scale change.
aspectPairs.saturn-uranus: Links tradition with change: the tension between stability and freedom; often generational.
aspectPairs.saturn-neptune: Links reality with dreams: giving form to ideals, or disillusionment; often generational.
aspectPairs.saturn-pluto: Links structure with power: endurance under pressure and deep restructuring; often generational.
aspectPairs.uranus-neptune: A generational link between innovation and ideals, shared by everyone born in these years.
aspectPairs.uranus-pluto: A generational link between change and transformation, shared by everyone born in these years.
aspectPairs.neptune-pluto: A very slow generational link between ideals and transformation, shared by whole generations.

planetCycles.sun: Your Sun meets its own natal place: a yearly checkpoint for identity, vitality and direction (the conjunction is your solar return).
planetCycles.moon: The Moon meets its own natal place every month: a monthly emotional reset.
planetCycles.mercury: A Mercury cycle: a fresh round of thinking, planning and conversation about your usual concerns.
planetCycles.venus: A Venus cycle: love, pleasure and what you value come back into focus.
planetCycles.mars: A Mars cycle (about two years): a new phase for drive, ambition and the way you assert yourself.
planetCycles.jupiter: A Jupiter cycle (about 12 years): a phase of growth, opportunity and widening horizons.
planetCycles.saturn: A Saturn cycle (about 29 years): a checkpoint of maturity, responsibility and long-term structure; squares and oppositions test what you have built.
planetCycles.uranus: A Uranus cycle (about 84 years): life-stage turning points around freedom and change; the opposition is the midlife awakening.
planetCycles.neptune: A Neptune cycle (about 165 years): slow shifts in ideals, faith and imagination; the square usually comes in midlife.
planetCycles.pluto: A Pluto cycle: slow, deep transformation of power and inner life; the square is a generational midlife marker.
planetCycles.chiron: A Chiron cycle (about 50 years): old wounds resurface to be healed; the return comes around age 50.
planetCycles.northNode: A nodal cycle (about 18.6 years): a turning point in life direction and purpose.

ceres.name: Ceres
ceres.short: Ceres shows how you give and receive care: nourishment, parenting and recovering after loss.

pallas.name: Pallas
pallas.short: Pallas shows how you solve problems: seeing patterns, building strategy and creative intelligence.

juno.name: Juno
juno.short: Juno shows what you need in a long-term relationship: commitment, equality and loyalty.

vesta.name: Vesta
vesta.short: Vesta shows where you devote yourself completely: concentration, dedication and inner fire.

vertex.name: Vertex
vertex.short: The Vertex is regarded as the point of encounters that feel fated and of unexpected events that change your course.

partOfSpirit.name: Part of Spirit
partOfSpirit.short: The Part of Spirit is the twin of the Part of Fortune: it shows your conscious intention and what you create by your own will.

selena.name: Selena (White Moon)
selena.short: Selena is traditionally read as the soul’s bright side, the reward for past kindness and a “guardian angel”.

jupiter.name: Jupiter return
jupiter.meaning: About every 12 years: the start of a new growth cycle, opportunities and expansion.

saturn.name: Saturn return
saturn.meaning: Around ages 29–30 and 58–60: a test of maturity, rebuilding the structures of your life and taking responsibility.

chiron.name: Chiron return
chiron.meaning: Around age 50: understanding old wounds and turning them into wisdom and the ability to help others.

profection.name: Profection year
profection.meaning: Each age “activates” one house and sign: the year’s theme is that house, and the lord of the year is the planet ruling that sign.

karmic.intro: In karmic astrology the lunar nodes show the habits the soul brings from the past and the direction it is meant to grow in this life. Chiron shows a deep wound and how it turns into wisdom; Lilith shows the repressed side that stays in the shadow.

aries.past: Your strength from the past is adapting, pleasing others and keeping relationships in balance. But compromising too much and leaving decisions to others can hold you back.
aries.future: Your path leads to independence, courage and saying clearly what you want. You learn to take the first step and to decide on your own.
aries.advice: Act without waiting for approval: healthy self-interest is your lesson.

taurus.past: You are used to crises, intense feelings and handling other people’s resources. Drama, control and the urge to change everything at the root are familiar ground.
taurus.future: Your path leads to calm, simple pleasures and building your own values. You learn to create stability with your own hands and to enjoy the present.
taurus.advice: Slow down instead of digging into everything: stability is not weakness.

gemini.past: Big truths, beliefs and certainty about being right are familiar ground. Thinking you already know and rushing to teach others can limit you.
gemini.future: Your path leads to asking with curiosity, listening and learning different points of view. Communication, study and your close surroundings help you grow.
gemini.advice: Ask before you answer: details matter as much as the big picture.

cancer.past: Responsibility, career, control and looking strong are familiar. Hiding feelings and carrying everything alone can be a habit.
cancer.future: Your path leads to your feelings, family and inner security. You learn to show vulnerability, accept care and allow emotional closeness.
cancer.advice: Do not measure success by status alone: put down roots at home and in the heart.

leo.past: Groups, friends, ideas and observing from the side are familiar ground. You may tend to hide your individuality behind the collective.
leo.future: Your path leads to expressing yourself from the heart, to creativity and to the courage to stand in the spotlight.
leo.advice: Put your own name on your ideas: do not be afraid to shine.

virgo.past: Dreams, compassion, intuition and going with the flow are familiar. Escaping reality and the victim role can be your test.
virgo.future: Your path leads to order, practical service and the value of everyday work. You learn to work with concrete steps, health and habits.
virgo.advice: Turn the dream into a plan: small, regular steps carry you forward.

libra.past: Independence, a fighting spirit and doing everything alone are familiar ground. Not seeing other people’s needs can be your test.
libra.future: Your path leads to cooperation, partnership and diplomacy. You learn to understand another point of view and to decide together.
libra.advice: Aim for agreement rather than victory.

scorpio.past: Stability, comfort, material security and resisting change are familiar ground. Getting stuck and possessiveness can hold you back.
scorpio.future: Your path leads to deep transformation, emotional intimacy and sharing resources with others. You learn to let go of the old and be reborn.
scorpio.advice: Do not fear change: you grow stronger as you let go.

sagittarius.past: Gathering information, talking a lot and knowing a little about everything are familiar ground. Getting lost in details and indecision can be your test.
sagittarius.future: Your path leads to meaning, philosophy, travel and your own truth. You learn to trust your intuition and to live by faith.
sagittarius.advice: You do not need to know everything: trust what your heart knows is right.

capricorn.past: Family, emotional security, attachment to the past and caretaking are familiar ground. Dependence and being ruled by feelings can be your test.
capricorn.future: Your path leads to responsibility, professional success and owning your life. You learn to build structure and to become a mature leader.
capricorn.advice: Leave the comfortable nest: set a goal and pursue it steadily.

aquarius.past: Attention, recognition, creative self-expression and personal drama are familiar ground. Needing everything to revolve around you can be your test.
aquarius.future: Your path leads to the collective, friendship, ideas and working for the common good. You learn to use your individuality in service of others.
aquarius.advice: Contribute without waiting for applause: the team helps you grow.

pisces.past: Analysis, order, criticism and the pursuit of perfection are familiar ground. The urge to control everything and worry can be your test.
pisces.future: Your path leads to faith, compassion, intuition and spirituality. You learn to let go and trust the whole.
pisces.advice: Do not try to fix every detail: sometimes letting go is the right step.

1.past: Old habit: building life around a partner and relationships.
1.future: Area of growth: discovering your own identity, wishes and independence.

2.past: Old habit: living through other people’s money, power and crises.
2.future: Area of growth: building your own values, your own income and inner stability.

3.past: Old habit: distant ideals, beliefs and assuming you already know.
3.future: Area of growth: your close surroundings, learning and everyday communication.

4.past: Old habit: shutting yourself into career, status and public role.
4.future: Area of growth: home, family and inner roots.

5.past: Old habit: dissolving into the group and staying on the sidelines.
5.future: Area of growth: creativity, love, joy and self-expression.

6.past: Old habit: withdrawing into solitude, dreams and escape.
6.future: Area of growth: daily work, health and useful service.

7.past: Old habit: doing everything alone and thinking only of yourself.
7.future: Area of growth: partnership, cooperation and equal relationships.

8.past: Old habit: holding tightly to your own possessions and comfort.
8.future: Area of growth: deep intimacy, shared resources and transformation.

9.past: Old habit: getting absorbed in details, small talk and information.
9.future: Area of growth: meaning, philosophy, education and far horizons.

10.past: Old habit: staying inside the comfort of family and home.
10.future: Area of growth: vocation, responsibility and public role.

11.past: Old habit: craving personal attention and self-centred creativity.
11.future: Area of growth: friendship, teamwork and shared goals.

12.past: Old habit: losing yourself in work, control and daily worries.
12.future: Area of growth: spirituality, intuition, rest in solitude and letting go.

nodeContacts.northNode: A planet conjunct the North Node is an energy that helps you on your future path: the more you develop it, the more the way opens.
nodeContacts.southNode: A planet conjunct the South Node is a ready-made talent from the past: you can rely on it, but do not stop there.
nodeContacts.square: A planet square the nodal axis is regarded as a “skipped step”: a theme left unfinished in the past that asks to be completed in this life.

chironSign.aries: The wound concerns asserting yourself and your right to exist: you may hesitate to show yourself. Healing comes from teaching others courage and how to take their place.
chironSign.taurus: The wound concerns security, the body and self-worth: there may be a feeling of “never enough”. Healing comes from finding stability in simple pleasures and in recognising your own worth.
chironSign.gemini: The wound concerns speaking, learning and being understood: you may feel your thoughts do not count. Healing comes from bringing clarity and comfort to others through words.
chironSign.cancer: The wound concerns family, care and emotional safety: you may have felt unloved or unprotected. Healing comes from giving deep care to others and to yourself.
chironSign.leo: The wound concerns self-expression and being seen: you may swing between needing attention and feeling ashamed. Healing comes from helping others shine and accepting your own creativity.
chironSign.virgo: The wound concerns perfection, health and being useful: you may feel you are never good enough. Healing comes from accepting imperfection while offering practical help.
chironSign.libra: The wound concerns relationships, fairness and being accepted: there may be a fear of abandonment. Healing comes from learning and teaching equal relationships with healthy boundaries.
chironSign.scorpio: The wound concerns trust, intimacy and loss: there may be a fear of betrayal. Healing comes from guiding others through crises and supporting deep transformation.
chironSign.sagittarius: The wound concerns faith, meaning and truth: you may doubt what life is for. Healing comes from sharing the wisdom your own experience has given you.
chironSign.capricorn: The wound concerns success, authority and recognition: however hard you work, it may never feel like enough. Healing comes from modelling healthy responsibility and resilience for others.
chironSign.aquarius: The wound concerns belonging and being different: you may feel like an outsider in groups. Healing comes from helping those who are different find their place.
chironSign.pisces: The wound concerns boundaries, spirituality and over-sensitivity: there may be an urge to escape the world. Healing comes from comforting others with compassion and intuition.

chironHouse.1: Area of wound and healing: yourself, your body and first impressions.
chironHouse.2: Area of wound and healing: money, possessions and self-worth.
chironHouse.3: Area of wound and healing: communication, education, siblings.
chironHouse.4: Area of wound and healing: family, home and roots.
chironHouse.5: Area of wound and healing: creativity, love and children.
chironHouse.6: Area of wound and healing: work, health and daily life.
chironHouse.7: Area of wound and healing: partnership and marriage.
chironHouse.8: Area of wound and healing: intimacy, crises and shared resources.
chironHouse.9: Area of wound and healing: faith, worldview and higher learning.
chironHouse.10: Area of wound and healing: career, status and public role.
chironHouse.11: Area of wound and healing: friendship, groups and hopes for the future.
chironHouse.12: Area of wound and healing: the inner world, solitude and hidden fears.

lilithSign.aries: Shadow: anger and demanding your way harshly; a suppressed will can burst out. Strength: being yourself without fear.
lilithSign.taurus: Shadow: over-attachment to pleasure and material things, or denying them entirely. Strength: accepting your body and pleasure without shame.
lilithSign.gemini: Shadow: manipulation with words, gossip, or silenced thoughts. Strength: speaking openly about forbidden topics.
lilithSign.cancer: Shadow: emotional dependence and old pain around family. Strength: not apologising for your feelings.
lilithSign.leo: Shadow: pride, doing anything to be recognised, or hiding yourself completely. Strength: shining without waiting for applause.
lilithSign.virgo: Shadow: excessive criticism, control and a passion for perfection. Strength: allowing yourself to be imperfect.
lilithSign.libra: Shadow: losing yourself in relationships, or controlling the partner. Strength: keeping your own terms within a partnership.
lilithSign.scorpio: Shadow: jealousy, control and power games. Strength: fearless intimacy and deep honesty.
lilithSign.sagittarius: Shadow: dogmatism, forcing your truth on others. Strength: living your own beliefs freely.
lilithSign.capricorn: Shadow: hunger for power, coldness, or rebellion against authority. Strength: building success by your own rules.
lilithSign.aquarius: Shadow: cold distance and opposing everything. Strength: living your difference without shame.
lilithSign.pisces: Shadow: escape, illusion and the victim role. Strength: trusting your intuition completely.

selenaSign.aries: Bright path: courage, standing up to injustice and protecting others. In these qualities help comes to you in hard moments.
selenaSign.taurus: Bright path: generosity, sharing the value you create and caring for nature. Simplicity protects you.
selenaSign.gemini: Bright path: speaking the truth, sharing knowledge and connecting people.
selenaSign.cancer: Bright path: care, protecting the family and being an emotional refuge for others.
selenaSign.leo: Bright path: sincere creativity, inspiring others and love from the heart.
selenaSign.virgo: Bright path: selfless service and practical support for those in need.
selenaSign.libra: Bright path: justice, reconciling people and honesty in relationships.
selenaSign.scorpio: Bright path: helping others out of crises and deep loyalty.

moonCalendar.voc: Void-of-course Moon: the time after the Moon makes its last exact aspect in a sign until it enters the next sign. Traditionally it is not recommended for starting new things, major decisions or contracts; it suits routine work, rest and reflection.
moonCalendar.lunarDay: A lunar day starts at the New Moon; each following lunar day starts at moonrise in the chosen city. So lunar days do not match calendar days and depend on the city.

tzolkin.intro: The Maya Tzolkin is the 260-day sacred calendar: 13 tones and 20 day signs. The sign of your birth day shows the core energy of your character, the tone how it is expressed. The traditional Maya count (GMT correlation) is used.

tones.13: Ascension: completion and a new cycle.

kua.intro: The Kua number (Feng Shui, “Eight Mansions” school) is calculated from the birth year (the Chinese year changes at Lichun, ~4 February) and gender. It shows your favourable directions: for a desk, a bed or a door.

natalChart.definition: A map of the sky for the exact moment and place of your birth: where the Sun, Moon and planets were in the zodiac and in the houses.

sign.definition: One of twelve 30° sections of the ecliptic (the Sun's apparent path). A planet's sign describes how its energy is expressed.

house.definition: One of twelve sectors of the chart, based on the time and place of birth. Houses show the areas of life where planetary energies play out.

houseSystem.definition: The method used to divide the sky into twelve houses (Placidus, Koch, Whole Sign, Equal…). Different systems can place a planet in a different house.

ascendant.definition: The zodiac degree rising on the eastern horizon at birth. It describes how you meet the world and starts the 1st house.

midheaven.definition: The highest point of the ecliptic in the sky at birth. It relates to career, reputation and direction in life.

aspect.definition: A meaningful angle between two points in the chart (0°, 60°, 90°, 120°, 180°…). Aspects show how planetary energies interact.

orb.definition: How far an aspect is from exact, in degrees. The smaller the orb, the stronger the aspect.

applying.definition: An applying aspect is getting closer to exact (building up); a separating aspect has passed exactness (fading).

retrograde.definition: Seen from Earth, a planet appears to move backwards through the zodiac for a while. Traditionally a time to review that planet's themes.

station.definition: The moment a planet appears to stand still before turning retrograde (SR) or direct (SD). Its themes are felt strongly around stations.

dignity.definition: How comfortable a planet is in a sign: domicile and exaltation strengthen it, detriment and fall challenge it.

sect.definition: Whether the Sun was above (day) or below (night) the horizon at birth. Traditional techniques such as firdaria depend on it.

nodes.definition: The two points where the Moon's orbit crosses the ecliptic. The North Node is linked to growth and direction, the South Node to the familiar past.

lilith.definition: The far point of the Moon's orbit (mean apogee). It is associated with raw, untamed instincts and what we suppress.

partOfFortune.definition: A calculated point (Ascendant + Moon − Sun by day) linked to well-being and where things flow easily.

transit.definition: Where a planet is in the sky now, compared with your natal chart. Transits describe what is being activated in your life at a given time.

progression.definition: A forecasting method where each day after birth stands for one year of life ("a day for a year").

solarArc.definition: All natal points are moved forward by the same arc the progressed Sun has travelled (about 1° a year).

return.definition: A chart for the moment the Sun (yearly) or Moon (monthly) returns to its exact natal position; it sets the tone for the cycle ahead.

profection.definition: A traditional technique: each year of life activates the next sign from the Ascendant; the ruler of that sign becomes the lord of the year.

firdaria.definition: A Persian system of planetary periods: life is divided into fixed-length chapters, each ruled by a planet, with seven sub-periods.

synastry.definition: Comparing two natal charts to see how two people's planets interact.

composite.definition: A single chart built from the midpoints of two people's planets; it describes the relationship itself.

voidOfCourse.definition: The time between the Moon's last major aspect in a sign and its entry into the next sign. Traditionally poor for starting new things.

lunation.definition: A phase of the Moon's monthly cycle: New Moon, First Quarter, Full Moon and Last Quarter.

ingress.definition: The moment a planet enters a new zodiac sign.

astrocartography.definition: A world map showing where each planet was rising, setting, culminating or at its lowest point at the moment of your birth.

ayanamsa.definition: The difference between the tropical and sidereal zodiacs (about 24° today). Vedic astrology uses the sidereal zodiac (Lahiri).

dasha.definition: The Vedic system of planetary periods (Vimshottari): a 120-year cycle whose starting point depends on the Moon's nakshatra.

nakshatra.definition: One of 27 lunar mansions (13°20′ each) used in Vedic astrology.

element.definition: Fire, earth, air or water: the four temperaments the signs are grouped into.

modality.definition: Cardinal, fixed or mutable: how a sign acts (starting, sustaining or adapting).

moonMansion.definition: One of 28 equal parts of the zodiac (about 12°51′ each, counted from 0° Aries) that the Moon passes through in a month; a medieval tradition with Arabic names.

eclipse.definition: A New Moon (solar eclipse) or Full Moon (lunar eclipse) that happens close to the Moon's nodes. Traditionally read as a stronger turning point than an ordinary lunation.

dispositor.definition: The ruler of the sign a planet is in. Every planet answers to the ruler of its sign; the chain closes on a planet in its own sign (the final dispositor).

draconic.definition: The same sky turned so that the North Node stands at 0° Aries. It is read as the soul-level pattern behind the natal chart.

house.10: Career and public life are in focus. You may feel more visible and more driven to achieve.

house.12: A quieter, more inward day: rest, reflection and solitude restore you; hidden feelings may surface.

new.1: A fresh start for you personally: a new look, a new approach, new beginnings in how you present yourself.
new.2: A new start with money and values: income, spending habits and what you truly want to own.
new.3: A new start in communication and learning: a course, a project, conversations that open new doors.
new.4: A new start at home and with family: moving, renovating or a new emotional foundation.
new.5: A new start in creativity, romance and joy: a creative project, a new love, time for play.
new.6: A new start in work and health: a new routine, new tasks or a habit you want to build.
new.7: A new start in partnership: meeting someone, renewing a commitment or a new way of relating.
new.8: A new start around shared resources and deep change: debts, joint finances or emotional healing.
new.9: A new start in learning, travel and beliefs: a trip, a course or a new way of seeing things.
new.10: A new start in career and public life: a new goal, role or direction you want to be known for.
new.11: A new start with friends and long-term hopes: new groups, new contacts, clearer plans for the future.
new.12: A quiet, inward start: rest, reflection and letting go of what is finished before the next cycle.

full.1: A matter about you personally comes to a head and is visible to others. Balance your own needs with those of the people close to you.
full.2: Money and values reach a point of clarity: results show up and you see what is worth keeping and what is not.
full.3: Communication peaks: news, decisions or conversations reach a conclusion and feelings about them are strong.
full.4: Feelings about home and family peak: an emotional matter at home comes to a head, or a family event brings people together.
full.5: Creative and romantic matters reach a culmination: a project is shown or feelings in love are at their strongest.
full.6: Work and health reach a turning point: the results of your effort show, and tiredness reminds you to adjust your routine.
full.7: A relationship matter comes to a head: commitments, agreements or conflicts with another person come into the open.
full.8: Deep feelings and shared resources come to a point: something hidden is revealed or a financial or emotional matter is resolved.
full.9: Plans, studies or journeys reach a high point: a result arrives or a belief you held is tested.
full.10: Career peaks: recognition, results or pressure at work are at their highest, and you see where your effort has led.
full.11: Friendships and group matters reach a culmination: a hope is met or let go, and your circle shows who is on your side.
full.12: A release of what was hidden or unfinished: rest is needed, and old feelings that surface are ready to be let go.

quarter.first_quarter: Waxing half Moon: a moment to act and push through the first obstacle of what you began at the New Moon.
quarter.last_quarter: Waning half Moon: a moment to review, let go and adjust what has not worked since the Full Moon.

eclipse.solar: Solar eclipse: a stronger-than-usual New Moon. Traditionally a turning point whose effects unfold over the next months; avoid rushed decisions and watch the house it touches.
eclipse.lunar: Lunar eclipse: a stronger-than-usual Full Moon. Traditionally an ending or a revelation in the area of the house it touches; effects can be felt for weeks.

house.1: This month your feelings are close to the surface and you take things personally; self-care and new starts are in focus.
house.2: This month's emotional focus is money, possessions and security; feeling safe depends on practical matters.
house.3: This month's focus is communication, learning, siblings and your surroundings; you need to talk things through.
house.4: This month's focus is home and family; you need privacy, comfort and emotional roots.
