house.6: This month's focus is daily work, routine and health; order and being useful settle you.
house.7: This month's focus is relationships and partnerships; your feelings are shaped by other people.
house.8: This month's focus is deep bonds, shared resources and change; emotions run strong and private.
house.9: This month's focus is travel, study and beliefs; you need wider horizons and meaning.
house.10: This month's focus is career and public life; you are more visible and more driven.
house.11: This month's focus is friends, groups and hopes; you find support among like-minded people.
house.12: This month's focus is rest, solitude and the inner life; time alone restores you and old feelings may surface.

asc.aries: You act directly and quickly this month; energy is high and patience is low.
asc.taurus: You move steadily and want comfort; a calm, practical month.
asc.gemini: You are curious and talkative; many contacts, news and short trips.
asc.cancer: You are sensitive and protective; home and family feel important.
asc.leo: You want to be seen and to enjoy yourself; warmth and confidence lead.
asc.virgo: You are careful and practical; details, health and routines matter.
asc.libra: You seek harmony and company; relationships and fairness are in focus.
asc.scorpio: You feel intensely and look beneath the surface; a month for depth and honesty.
asc.sagittarius: You are optimistic and restless; you want freedom, movement and new ideas.
asc.capricorn: You are serious and focused; responsibilities and goals come first.
asc.aquarius: You feel independent and original; friends, ideas and change attract you.
asc.pisces: You are dreamy and sensitive; intuition and rest matter more than planning.

jupiter.1: A period of confidence and opportunity: you grow personally, and life opens up when you take initiative.
jupiter.2: Income and resources can grow; a good time to build money, skills and a sense of worth.
jupiter.3: Learning, writing, contacts and short trips bring opportunities; your circle of communication widens.
jupiter.4: Growth at home and in the family: a bigger or better home, support from relatives, a stronger base.
jupiter.5: Joy, creativity and romance expand; a good time for love, children and projects you enjoy.
jupiter.6: Opportunities in work and daily life, and a good time to improve health habits and routines.
jupiter.7: Partnerships bring growth: meeting helpful people, a good time for agreements, marriage or business ties.
jupiter.8: Support through shared resources: loans, investments, inheritance or deep emotional growth.
jupiter.9: Travel, study and big ideas open up; a time to widen your horizons and test your beliefs.
jupiter.10: Career growth and recognition: a favourable time to advance, take a larger role and be seen.
jupiter.11: Friends, groups and long-term hopes bring luck; useful contacts and a clearer vision of the future.
jupiter.12: A quiet, protective period: rest, inner growth and hidden support; a time to prepare for the next cycle.

saturn.1: A serious turning point for you personally: more responsibility, a new level of maturity and a changed image.
saturn.2: Money and values are tested: budgets, earning your keep and building lasting security step by step.
saturn.3: Communication and learning need discipline: serious study, careful words and sorting out your surroundings.
saturn.4: Home and family carry weight: responsibilities for relatives, repairs or a move, and rebuilding your foundations.
saturn.5: Joy and creativity ask for effort: love and children bring responsibility, and creative work needs discipline.
saturn.6: Work and health are in focus: heavier workload, a need for routine and a reminder to look after your body.
saturn.7: Relationships are tested: commitments are made or ended, and you learn what you really want from a partner.
saturn.8: Shared money and deep matters need care: debts, joint finances, and facing fears to gain real strength.
saturn.9: Beliefs and long plans are tested: serious study, responsible travel and a worldview built on experience.
saturn.10: A peak of responsibility in career: a demanding role, slow but solid achievement and a test of your reputation.
saturn.11: Friendships and goals are sorted out: fewer but more loyal friends, and a realistic plan for the future.
saturn.12: A heavy, inward period: fears and old burdens surface to be dealt with; rest and solitude are necessary.

uranus.1: Sudden change in who you are: a new look, new independence and a strong urge to break from the old you.
uranus.2: Money and values shift unexpectedly: unusual income, sudden expenses and a new view of what you own.
uranus.3: Your thinking speeds up: new ideas, sudden news, new ways of learning and communicating.
uranus.4: Home and family change suddenly: a move, a break with the past or an unusual home life.
uranus.5: Surprises in love and creativity: sudden romances, unusual projects and a need for freedom in what you enjoy.
uranus.6: Daily work and health routines are shaken up: a job change, new technology or a new way of living.
uranus.7: Relationships change suddenly: unexpected meetings or breakups, and a need for space with partners.
uranus.8: Sudden shifts in shared finances and deep matters: unexpected gains or losses and psychological breakthroughs.
uranus.9: Beliefs and horizons change: sudden trips, new ideas and a break from old ways of thinking.
uranus.10: Your career can take an unexpected turn: sudden changes of role, new directions and a push toward independence.
uranus.11: Friends, groups and goals are shaken up: new circles, unusual allies and a changed vision of your future.
uranus.12: Sudden insights from within: hidden patterns break open, and you free yourself from old, unseen limits.

neptune.1: Your identity softens and becomes more sensitive and imaginative; guard against losing your sense of self.
neptune.2: Money and values become unclear: idealism about money, so keep finances clear and avoid risky promises.
neptune.3: Thinking turns intuitive and dreamy; communication can be inspired but also vague, so check the details.
neptune.4: Home and family feel idealised or unclear; a longing for a peaceful, almost spiritual home.
neptune.5: Creativity and romance are inspired but easily idealised; art flourishes, and so does the risk of illusion in love.
neptune.6: Work and health need care: sensitivity to stress and environment, and a pull toward service or healing.
neptune.7: Partners are idealised and boundaries blur; compassion grows, but see people as they really are.
neptune.8: Deep, hidden feelings and shared resources become unclear; be careful with joint money and with secrets.
neptune.9: Beliefs turn spiritual and idealistic; faith and inspiration grow, as does the risk of following illusions.
neptune.10: Career direction becomes unclear or shifts toward art, care or ideals; your public image softens.
neptune.11: Friendships and hopes are idealised; inspiring circles, but choose companions and causes with clear eyes.
neptune.12: A deeply spiritual, dreamy period: intuition and compassion grow; you need solitude and healthy boundaries.

pluto.1: A deep transformation of who you are: you shed an old self and grow stronger, with intense personal change.
pluto.2: Money and values are rebuilt from the ground: loss and gain, and a new relationship with what you own.
pluto.3: Thinking and communication deepen: powerful words, hidden truths coming out, and a changed mind.
pluto.4: Home and family are transformed: deep family matters surface, and your emotional foundation is rebuilt.
pluto.5: Love, creativity and children bring intense experiences; passion and power struggles ask for honesty.
pluto.6: Work and health are overhauled: deep changes in habits, jobs and your relationship to your body.
pluto.7: Relationships are transformed: intense bonds, endings and rebirths, and power dynamics that must be faced.
pluto.8: The deepest transformation: crisis and rebirth around intimacy, shared resources and what you keep hidden.
pluto.9: Beliefs are broken down and rebuilt: a deep change in your worldview through study, travel or crisis.
pluto.10: Career and public life are transformed: power, reputation and direction change, often through intense events.
pluto.11: Friends, groups and goals are transformed: some ties end, others deepen, and your vision of the future is reborn.
pluto.12: A deep inner transformation: the unconscious brings up what was buried, and real healing becomes possible.

planet.mercury: Mercury retrograde: communication, travel and technology need extra care. A time to review, re-read, back up and finish old matters rather than sign new contracts.
planet.venus: Venus retrograde: love, money and values are reviewed. Old relationships and spending habits come back for a second look; avoid big purchases or rash commitments.
planet.mars: Mars retrograde (about every two years): energy and drive slow down and turn inward. Revisit goals and frustrations before pushing forward.
planet.jupiter: Jupiter retrograde: growth turns inward. A time to digest recent expansion, review beliefs and plans, and find real meaning rather than chase more.
planet.saturn: Saturn retrograde: a time to review your responsibilities and structures, to find what is truly solid and what must be rebuilt.
planet.uranus: Uranus retrograde: the urge for change turns inward; reflect on how you want to be free before making sudden moves.
planet.neptune: Neptune retrograde: illusions fade and the picture clears. Dreams and ideals are reviewed, and it becomes easier to see things as they are.
planet.pluto: Pluto retrograde: deep change works under the surface; a time for inner work, facing what you have buried and taking back your own power.

asc.cancer: A sensitive, home-centred year: family and emotional security come first.
asc.leo: A confident, visible year: you want to shine, create and be recognised.
asc.virgo: A careful, practical year: details, health, work and improving things matter.
asc.libra: A social, balancing year: relationships, fairness and cooperation shape your choices.
asc.scorpio: An intense, transformative year: you look beneath the surface and face what is hidden.
asc.sagittarius: An optimistic, restless year: travel, learning and a search for meaning.
asc.capricorn: A serious, goal-driven year: responsibilities, structure and long-term plans.
asc.aquarius: An independent, original year: friends, ideas and change attract you.
asc.pisces: A dreamy, intuitive year: sensitivity, imagination and a need for rest.

house.1: A year of personal focus: your health, appearance and independence take centre stage, and what you start now sets the tone.
house.2: A year of money and resources: earning, spending, possessions and self-worth are in the spotlight.
house.3: A year of communication and learning: siblings, neighbours, studies, writing and short trips are active.
house.4: A year of home and roots: family, property, parents and your inner foundation come to the front.
house.5: A year of creativity and joy: romance, children, hobbies and self-expression are highlighted.
house.6: A year of work and health: daily routines, service, employees and the body need attention.
house.7: A year of partnership: marriage, close relationships, clients and open rivals are in focus.
house.8: A year of depth and change: shared money, debts, intimacy, endings and renewal come forward.
house.9: A year of expansion: travel, higher learning, publishing, faith and foreign contacts are active.
house.10: A year of career and standing: ambition, reputation, authority and public achievement are highlighted.
house.11: A year of friends and goals: groups, networks, allies and long-term hopes are in focus.
house.12: A year of retreat and inner work: rest, solitude, hidden matters and endings prepare the next cycle.

planet.jupiter: Jupiter moves through the zodiac in about twelve years, so each of its contacts is brief: usually a few months, with up to three exact dates. It brings growth, opportunity, confidence and generosity, and it magnifies whatever it touches: good plans grow, but so do excess, overspending and overconfidence. Its periods are often remembered as the time a door opened: a trip, a teacher, a job offer, a move, a wider circle. The best use is to say yes to what is already promising and to add some structure so that the growth lasts.
planet.saturn: Saturn takes about twenty-nine and a half years to go round the zodiac. Its contacts last longer, often most of a year with three exact dates, and they ask for maturity: commitment, discipline, realism and responsibility. Pressure, delays or a sense of heaviness are common, but so is the reward of work done properly. Saturn rarely takes away what was built on solid ground; it tests what was built on hope alone. Its periods are good for finishing, structuring, saying no, and building habits and obligations you will still want in ten years.
planet.uranus: Uranus needs about eighty-four years for one circuit, so its contacts are rare and each lasts a year or more, with several passes. It breaks routines: sudden changes, a need for freedom, unexpected people and events, new technology, impatience with whatever has become a cage. The change often looks sudden from outside but has been building inside. Handled well, it frees you from something outdated and shows who you are without it; handled badly, it becomes impulsive breaks for the sake of breaking. Keep one stable base, and let the changes that are needed happen on purpose.
planet.neptune: Neptune circles the zodiac in about one hundred and sixty-five years, so most people meet each of its contacts once in a lifetime. It works slowly and softly, like fog or tide: it dissolves boundaries and raises inspiration, compassion, longing and faith, and also confusion, illusion, escapism and disappointment. Things you thought were clear may lose their outline, and ideals may be tested against reality. It is a good time for art, spiritual practice, rest and forgiveness, and a poor time for signing what you do not understand or trusting promises that sound too good. Ask for facts when something matters.
planet.pluto: Pluto takes about two hundred and forty-eight years to go round, and its contacts can last two years or more. It works at the root: power, control, loss, rebirth. What no longer serves is pulled out and what is hidden comes into view, often through intense relationships, crises or a decision not to go on as before. It is rarely comfortable, but it is the most thorough kind of renewal: afterwards you are less afraid of what you were afraid of. Do not fight the process for control; work on the part that is yours, and let go of what has already ended.
planet.mars: Mars goes round the zodiac in about two years, so its contacts are short: a few days or weeks, often with several passes during a retrograde. It brings energy, action, competition and irritation. A Mars contact is good for starting work, having a hard conversation or using up physical energy; it also raises the risk of hasty reactions, quarrels and accidents. Direct the energy at a clear goal.

aspect.conjunction: A conjunction is the strongest contact: the transiting planet sits on top of your natal point and merges with it. It opens a new chapter in that area of life, with the theme at its most visible and hard to ignore. The beginning is often felt as a seed rather than a result; what you do now sets the tone for years.
aspect.square: A square creates friction and pushes you to act. Two sides of you pull in different directions and neither can be ignored, so tension builds until something is decided. It is the aspect of effort and of breakthrough through difficulty: uncomfortable while it lasts, but it is where much of the growth happens.
aspect.opposition: An opposition sets two things face to face, often through other people or outer events: what you meet across the table mirrors something in you. The task is balance and perspective, not choosing one side. These periods show what has been one-sided, and relationships usually carry the theme.
aspect.trine: A trine flows easily. The two energies support each other and things go with less effort, so it brings talent, luck and ease. Its weakness is that ease does not push you: the gift can be wasted if nothing is done with it. Use it on something you want to last.
aspect.sextile: A sextile is a quiet opportunity: a door that opens if you step toward it. It is gentler than a trine or a square and rarely forces anything, so it is easy to miss. Say yes to invitations, conversations and small chances in this area and they can grow into something solid.

target.sun: Your natal Sun is your core: identity, vitality, purpose and the way you want to shine. A contact here touches how you see yourself and what you are living for. Expect questions about direction, changes in confidence or in your role, and often a clearer sense of who you are becoming.
target.moon: Your natal Moon is your inner life: feelings, needs, habits, home and the sense of safety. A contact here is felt in mood and in daily life: changes at home or in the family, shifts in what comforts you, and emotions that ask for attention. Look after sleep, routine and the people who feel like home.
target.mercury: Your natal Mercury is thought and communication: how you learn, speak, decide and process information. A contact here brings new ideas, study, paperwork, negotiations, short trips or mental overload. Choose your words and signatures with care, because what you say now leaves a mark.
target.venus: Your natal Venus is love, values, pleasure and your relationship with money. A contact here brings changes in relationships, taste, spending and earning: you rethink whom and what you value. A new acquaintance, a parting, a reconciliation or a financial decision can all be faces of this theme.
target.mars: Your natal Mars is energy, desire, courage and anger: how you act, compete and defend your boundaries. A contact here raises drive, rivalry, physical energy and friction. Put the energy into exercise, work and clear action, and avoid hasty reactions.
target.jupiter: Your natal Jupiter is faith, growth, outlook and luck. A contact here reshapes your beliefs, the scale of your plans and what you trust. Education, travel, law or a spiritual search are the usual routes of this theme.
target.saturn: Your natal Saturn is structure, responsibility, limits and maturity: what you carry on your own shoulders and what you can build. A contact here brings a re-evaluation of career, obligations and discipline. Strengthen what is truly yours and let go of what you took on from other people's expectations.
target.uranus: Your natal Uranus is individuality, freedom and awakening: what sets you apart and gets you out of the cage. A contact here opens new sides of your identity and shows what you have to leave behind. Sudden choices and unexpected meetings are common.
target.neptune: Your natal Neptune is ideals, intuition, dreams and spirituality. A contact here touches what you believe in, what you dream of and what mystery draws you. Feelings deepen, but boundaries and reality checks are needed.
target.pluto: Your natal Pluto is power, depth and renewal: what you cannot let go of and what you fear. A contact here reaches the deepest layers: control, loss, secrets coming to light and rebirth. It is slow, serious change; patience and honesty help.
target.asc: Your Ascendant is your doorway to the world: body, appearance and the way you start new things. A contact here can change how you look, how you present yourself and your approach to life. It is often a new start, a new image or a new setting.
target.mc: Your Midheaven (MC) is career, public image and life direction. A contact here redefines your professional path, your reputation and what you present to the world. A change of job, promotion, a shift of purpose or public attention are the usual routes.

saturn-conjunction.name: Saturn return
saturn-conjunction.text: The Saturn return happens when Saturn comes back to the place it held at your birth: around ages 28 to 30, and again near 58 and 88. It is the classic coming of age of adult life. Questions arrive about what you are building: career, partnerships, where you live, what you owe yourself and others. What was borrowed from other people's expectations tends to fall away, and what is truly yours stays and gets stronger. It is rarely easy, but people usually describe it afterwards as the time they grew up on their own terms. Because of retrograde motion the return is felt in three waves over about a year.

saturn-square.name: Saturn square
saturn-square.text: The Saturn square happens when Saturn is a quarter of the circle from its birth place, about every seven years (around 7, 22, 37, 51 and 66). It is a checkpoint: an old structure no longer fits and something concrete has to be built or changed. It asks for a decision rather than a feeling; the usual themes are work, responsibilities and the limit of what you carry.

saturn-opposition.name: Saturn opposition
saturn-opposition.text: The Saturn opposition falls at half the circle: around ages 14 to 15 and 44. It is the midpoint of the cycle. Near 44 it is the midlife check: you compare what you have built with what you want. Relationships and responsibilities hold up a mirror, and sometimes other people show you your own limits. The task is balance between obligations and your own needs.

jupiter-conjunction.name: Jupiter return
jupiter-conjunction.text: Jupiter returns to its birth place roughly every twelve years (around ages 12, 24, 36, 48 and 60). It is a renewal of faith and direction: optimism rises and a new chapter of growth, learning or travel opens. A good time to set goals and take a bigger step. Just avoid excess: Jupiter magnifies everything, the good and the waste.

jupiter-opposition.name: Jupiter opposition
jupiter-opposition.text: Jupiter opposes its birth place six years after a return (around ages 6, 18, 30 and 42). It is the midpoint of the cycle: opportunities come through other people, and you can see what the last growth phase gave you. Watch that you do not overextend.

uranus-square.name: Uranus square
uranus-square.text: The Uranus square happens around ages 20 to 22. It is the first break-away: independence, leaving family expectations and choosing your own road. Sudden decisions, moving out, new friends and a rebuilt identity are common. Freedom is very attractive; it matters to know what you are leaving and what you are joining.

uranus-trine.name: Uranus trine
uranus-trine.text: The Uranus trine happens around age 28. It is a gentle awakening: change arrives with ease rather than force, and new freedoms and talents appear. A calm moment to try something different; it often overlaps the Saturn return and softens its pressure.

uranus-opposition.name: Uranus opposition
uranus-opposition.text: The Uranus opposition happens around ages 40 to 44 and is known as the midlife awakening. An urge arises to change whatever has become routine: restructuring, sometimes a sharp turn, a re-evaluation of relationships and career. A change that looks sudden has usually been building for years. It is a chance to find your real wants; change on purpose rather than tearing down for its own sake.

neptune-square.name: Neptune square
neptune-square.text: The Neptune square happens around ages 40 to 42. It is a time of disillusion and spiritual searching: what you believed in is questioned, dreams never lived come into view and the need for meaning grows. Confusion and tiredness are possible, but so is replacing expectations with something more honest. Make important decisions with documents and checked facts.

northNode-conjunction.name: Nodal return
northNode-conjunction.text: The Moon's node returns to its birth place about every 18.6 years (around ages 18 to 19, 37, 56 and 74). It is a checkpoint of direction: it becomes clear which road suits you and what has turned into mere habit. Serious decisions about work, relationships or where to live often fall in this period. Events can feel as if they were written in advance; what matters is to see the lesson and choose the direction consciously.

chiron-conjunction.name: Chiron return
chiron-conjunction.text: Chiron returns to its birth place at about age 50. It is the wounded-healer period: a sensitivity and hurt carried for many years comes into view, and it becomes possible to make peace with it and help others. A passage into the second half of life is often felt: you rebuild what you live for and pass your experience on. A new look at old wounds is where healing begins.

planet.sun: The Sun answers the question “who am I?” in your chart: identity, will, vitality and the purpose you want to live for. Its sign gives your basic character colour, and its house shows where you most want to express it. In charts where the Sun is well supported a person shines more the better they know themselves; with tense aspects, building an identity may take more effort. The Sun answers “what for?”: whatever gets you out of bed in the morning.
planet.moon: The Moon is your inner world: feelings, needs, habits, childhood imprints and the sense of safety. The Sun shows who you want to be, the Moon what you need. Its sign describes how you feel, and its house where you find comfort. Its aspects affect how steady or changeable your emotions are. Listening to what the Moon needs is the fastest way to calm down under stress.
planet.mercury: Mercury is the way you think, speak, learn and handle information: how you ask, explain, write and decide. Its sign shows the style of your mind (quick, thorough, practical, intuitive), and its house the area where your thinking works hardest. Mercury stays close to the Sun, so many people have it in the same sign or the next one. A retrograde Mercury often gives a more inward mind that thinks first and speaks later.
planet.venus: Venus is love, attraction, pleasure, values and your relationship with money. Its sign shows what you love and how you show affection, and its house where you find pleasure and closeness. It answers “what do I value?”: people, things, beauty and yourself. Its aspects shape how easy or complicated relationships are and how secure you feel about money.
planet.mars: Mars is your energy, desire, courage and anger: how you act, compete, set boundaries and go after what you want. Its sign shows your style of action (direct, patient, strategic, impulsive), and its house where you put most of your energy. A healthy Mars is will and decisiveness; when blocked it shows up as anger and tension. Physical activity is the simplest outlet.
planet.jupiter: Jupiter is growth, faith, optimism, outlook and luck. Its sign colours your beliefs and your way of learning, and its house shows where in life you expand most and find success more easily. It relates to “what do I believe in?”: education, travel, law, philosophy and generosity. Jupiter's weakness is excess: promising, spending or spreading yourself too much.
planet.saturn: Saturn is structure, responsibility, limits, discipline and maturity. Its sign shows the style of your inner demands and fears, and its house the area where you have to work hardest and can build the most lasting thing. Saturn often feels like a lack, but over time it becomes the greatest source of strength: what you build patiently is truly yours. Making peace with it means setting yourself realistic goals.
planet.uranus: Uranus is individuality, freedom, innovation and sudden change. Since it stays about seven years in a sign, its sign says more about your generation, and its house about the area of life where you break rules and are different. With strong Uranus aspects a person feels “unlike the others” early and tends to choose their own road. Freedom without discipline can turn into confusion.
planet.neptune: Neptune is dreaming, inspiration, intuition, spirituality and the dissolving of boundaries. Since it stays about fourteen years in a sign, its sign speaks of the ideals of a generation, and its house of the area where you are most sensitive, dreamy or easily deceived. Its good side is creativity, compassion and faith; its hard side is escapism, illusion and being easily influenced. A habit of checking reality is the key to living with Neptune.
planet.pluto: Pluto is power, depth, crisis and renewal. Since it stays from twelve to thirty years in a sign, its sign describes a generational theme, and its house the area of life where you go through the deepest changes. The themes it touches often involve strong feelings, control and loss, but by working with them a person finds the greatest power of renewal. Bringing what is hidden to light is Pluto's work.
planet.northNode: The North Node (the Moon's ascending node) points in the direction of growth: qualities that are not yet familiar but that you develop. Its sign and house answer “where should I grow?” The road feels uncomfortable at first because it is not what you are used to, but meaning grows with every step you take toward it.
planet.southNode: The South Node shows the skills and comfortable habits you bring from the past: what comes easily but can turn into stagnation if repeated. Its sign and house say what you lean on too much. The aim is not to drop it but to use it as a talent while moving toward the North Node.
planet.lilith: Black Moon Lilith shows the wild, suppressed or unaccepted side of the chart: the wish to be yourself regardless of others, your own boundaries and hidden passions. Its sign and house show where you need to say no or be yourself. It is a secondary point, used for interpretation rather than prediction.
planet.chiron: Chiron is the wounded healer: an early hurt and sensitivity that later becomes the ability to help others. Its sign and house show where you are sensitive and how you can heal through your own experience. Working with Chiron means understanding the wound rather than hiding it, and that understanding often becomes your most valuable gift.
planet.partOfFortune: The Part of Fortune is a calculated point from the relationship of the Sun, Moon and Ascendant, and traditionally shows where ease and good fortune come naturally. Its sign and house say where things go more smoothly when you turn toward them. It is not a planet but a helpful direction.
planet.asc: The Ascendant (rising sign) is your doorway to the world: your appearance, first impression, body language and approach to new situations. If the Sun is who you are inside, the Ascendant is the face others meet first. It is the start of the chart's house system and depends on the birth time, because it changes roughly every two hours.
planet.mc: The Midheaven (MC) is the highest point of the chart: career, public image, reputation and life direction. Its sign shows how you want to be seen in public and which professional style suits you. The MC depends on the birth time and is often tied to the question “what will I contribute to the world?”
planet.dc: The Descendant (opposite the Ascendant) shows the pull toward people who complete you: partners, close collaborators and open rivals. Its sign describes qualities you look for in others or project onto them. It points to the side of yourself you are meant to develop through relationships.
planet.ic: The Imum Coeli (IC) is the deepest point of the chart: roots, family, home and inner security. Its sign shows the tone of the childhood environment and where you feel at home. It sits opposite the Midheaven and reminds you of the balance between career and inner support.

sign.aries: Aries is the first and most direct fire sign: beginnings, courage, competition and initiative. A planet here likes to move fast, start without waiting and go its own way. Its strengths are energy and honesty; its weaknesses are impatience, haste and not adjusting to other people's pace.
sign.taurus: Taurus is a fixed earth sign: steadiness, the senses, material security and pleasure. A planet here likes to move slowly and surely, wants real, tangible results and comfort. Its strengths are patience and loyalty; its weaknesses are stubbornness, resistance to change and too much attachment to possessions.
sign.gemini: Gemini is a mutable air sign: curiosity, words, connection and flexibility. A planet here likes to learn and talk about many things at once and to move on to new information. Its strengths are adaptability and communication; its weaknesses are scatter, superficiality and indecision.
sign.cancer: Cancer is a cardinal water sign: care, home, feeling and memory. A planet here acts protectively and sensitively, tied to family and roots. Its strengths are empathy and loyalty; its weaknesses are over-sensitivity, attachment to the past and withdrawing into a shell.
sign.leo: Leo is a fixed fire sign: heart, creativity, pride and generosity. A planet here likes to be seen, loved and to show its talent. Its strengths are a warm heart, leadership and loyalty; its weaknesses are the need for recognition, pride and taking criticism hard.
sign.virgo: Virgo is a mutable earth sign: analysis, service, detail and improvement. A planet here likes to be useful, to fix and to put things in order. Its strengths are precision and practicality; its weaknesses are over-criticism, perfectionism and worry.
sign.libra: Libra is a cardinal air sign: balance, relationship, beauty and fairness. A planet here seeks harmony, sees the other person's view and cooperates. Its strengths are diplomacy and taste; its weaknesses are indecision, avoiding conflict and wanting to please others.
sign.scorpio: Scorpio is a fixed water sign: depth, passion, secrecy and renewal. A planet here does not stay on the surface; it looks beneath everything and commits fully or not at all. Its strengths are endurance, intuition and the power to change; its weaknesses are suspicion, control and resentment.
sign.sagittarius: Sagittarius is a mutable fire sign: freedom, search, optimism and meaning. A planet here reaches for far horizons, learning and philosophical questions. Its strengths are candour and a wide view; its weaknesses are hasty promises, impatience with detail and bluntness.
sign.capricorn: Capricorn is a cardinal earth sign: ambition, responsibility, structure and results. A planet here thinks in plans and over the long term and endures. Its strengths are discipline and reliability; its weaknesses are rigidity, overwork and putting feelings second.
sign.aquarius: Aquarius is a fixed air sign: individuality, ideas, friendship and the future. A planet here thinks originally, serves a group or an ideal, but keeps an emotional distance. Its strengths are innovation and objectivity; its weaknesses are stubborn opinions, coolness and being different just to be different.
sign.pisces: Pisces is a mutable water sign: sensitivity, imagination, compassion and spirituality. A planet here crosses boundaries easily, feels other people and lives by imagination. Its strengths are inspiration and compassion; its weaknesses are escapism, unclear boundaries and being swayed by others.

house.1: The 1st house is the house of the self, the body, appearance and new beginnings. A planet here strongly affects your first impression and your direct approach to life. These themes show quickly: others know you by this energy.
house.2: The 2nd house is the house of money, possessions, talents and self-worth. A planet here shows how you build material security and what you value. Income, spending and self-confidence are the themes that open in this house.
house.3: The 3rd house is the house of communication, learning, short trips, siblings and the near environment. A planet here colours your way of thinking and speaking, your daily contacts and how you handle information. Writing, conversation and relations with those close to you are its main themes.
house.4: The 4th house is the house of home, family, roots and inner security. A planet here shows traces of the childhood environment, the relationship with parents and where you feel at home. It is the most private and hidden area of the chart.
house.5: The 5th house is the house of creativity, romance, play, children and self-expression. A planet here shows how you enjoy yourself, love and show who you are. Hobbies, flirting, relations with children and taking risks are the themes of this house.
house.6: The 6th house is the house of work, daily routine, health and service. A planet here shows your daily habits, working environment and the way you look after your body. Routines, improvement and being useful to others are the themes of this house.
house.7: The 7th house is the house of marriage, partnership, close collaboration and open rivals. A planet here shows what you look for in relationships and the kind of people you attract. The theme of “we”, commitment and seeing yourself mirrored in others opens in this house.
house.8: The 8th house is the house of shared resources, debts, inheritance, intimacy and transformation. A planet here shows how you share money and feeling with others, and how you deal with loss and renewal. Secrets, deep psychology and renewal after crisis are its themes.
house.9: The 9th house is the house of long journeys, higher education, philosophy, law and outlook. A planet here shows where you look for meaning and how you understand the world. Going abroad, learning, teaching and beliefs are the themes of this house.
house.10: The 10th house is the house of career, public standing, reputation and life purpose. A planet here shows your professional path, your idea of achievement and how you are known in society. Responsibility, authority and long-term results are the themes of this house.
house.11: The 11th house is the house of friends, groups, hopes and future goals. A planet here shows your relation to the community, your ideals and the people you join to make dreams real. Networks, shared projects and long-term wishes are the themes of this house.
house.12: The 12th house is the house of the hidden, solitude, spirituality, hospitals and the unconscious. A planet here shows your unseen side, your fears and the place where you retreat to rest. Meditation, solitude and behind-the-scenes work are its themes; often these only become clear with time.

aspect.conjunction: A conjunction is two planets standing at the same point: the energies merge, become inseparable or strengthen each other. It is the strongest contact in a chart; the theme is obvious and often expressed as one. If the planets are compatible it gives great strength; if not it can create inner confusion.
aspect.opposition: An opposition is two planets facing each other: two needs on opposite poles that call for balance. Often you live one side yourself and see the other in other people. The lesson is not to choose a side but to combine both; once you learn that, relationships and decisions become more balanced.
aspect.trine: A trine is a natural, easy harmony between two planets: the energies help each other and talent flows with little effort. These talents often feel ordinary because they come easily, but they can be wasted if not developed. A trine is a strength, not a demand: you choose what to direct it toward.
aspect.square: A square is friction and tension between two planets: two wants pull in different directions and neither gives way. This aspect often becomes the biggest motivation in life because it forces you to act, look for solutions and grow. It is not comfortable, but much of the growth comes from it.
aspect.sextile: A sextile is a soft opportunity between two planets: the energies support each other but do not act by themselves. It is a door that opens if you step toward it. A sextile usually shows quiet talents and practical opportunities; using them takes conscious effort.

sun.aries: Your Sun is in Aries: you know yourself in action, initiative and new beginnings. Courage, competition and speaking directly come naturally; waiting or repeating feels constricting. Your energy is high and fast, but impatience and quick cooling are the risks. You are at your best when you lead, take a test or do something first. Your lesson is to turn bluntness into courageous care.
sun.taurus: Your Sun is in Taurus: you know yourself in steadiness, quality and real results. Pleasure, beauty, food, nature and material comfort matter to you. You are slow to change, but once you decide you go all the way. Your strengths are reliability and patience; your weaknesses stubbornness and resistance to change. Your lesson is to build a sense of worth that does not depend on what you own.
sun.gemini: Your Sun is in Gemini: you know yourself in curiosity, conversation and the exchange of ideas. Knowing a little about many things and explaining it to someone else is your lifeblood. You are flexible, witty and adaptable; scatter and superficiality are the risks. You are at your best learning, writing, talking and connecting people. Your lesson is to stay with one subject in depth.
sun.cancer: Your Sun is in Cancer: you know yourself in care, family and emotional bonds. Home, food, memories and protecting loved ones are what gives life meaning. You are sensitive, intuitive and loyal; you can hold on to hurt for a long time. You are at your best when you create a safe place for others. Your lesson is to look after your own needs too.
sun.leo: Your Sun is in Leo: you know yourself in creativity, generosity and heartfelt expression. Being seen, loved and showing your talent are natural needs. You are warm, fun and loyal; criticism and indifference hurt you a lot. You are at your best when you inspire others and are on stage. Your lesson is to find self-belief that does not depend on applause.
sun.virgo: Your Sun is in Virgo: you know yourself in usefulness, precision and improvement. Seeing detail, putting things in order and helping others in practical ways gives you meaning. You are intelligent, modest and hard-working; you can be too critical of yourself. You are at your best when you fix something skilfully. Your lesson is to accept “good enough”.
sun.libra: Your Sun is in Libra: you know yourself in relationship, harmony and the search for fairness. Beauty, taste and seeing the other person's view are your strengths. You are courteous and diplomatic; indecision and avoiding conflict are the risks. You are at your best reconciling sides and cooperating. Your lesson is to say what you think even when it creates discomfort.
sun.scorpio: Your Sun is in Scorpio: you know yourself in depth, passion and renewal. Small talk constricts you; you want truth, mystery and the hidden side of people. You are determined, intuitive and loyal; suspicion, control and resentment are the risks. You are at your best coming out of a crisis stronger and in deep relationships. Your lesson is to trust and to let go.
sun.sagittarius: Your Sun is in Sagittarius: you know yourself in freedom, search and making meaning. Travel, learning, philosophy and wide horizons energise you. You are optimistic, candid and bold; hasty promises and bluntness are the risks. You are at your best meeting new places, ideas and people. Your lesson is to see commitment as a form of freedom too.
sun.capricorn: Your Sun is in Capricorn: you know yourself in purpose, responsibility and results. Making long-term plans, enduring difficulty and building something solid over time are your strengths. You are serious, reliable and disciplined; rigidity and putting everything but work second are the risks. You are at your best when you see the results of what you build. Your lesson is to count rest and showing feeling as part of the work.
sun.aquarius: Your Sun is in Aquarius: you know yourself in individuality, ideas and a view of the future. Thinking originally, working for the good of a group and questioning rules come naturally. You are independent, humane and open-minded; emotional distance and stubbornness are the risks. You are at your best turning a new idea into shared work. Your lesson is to leave room for closeness too.
sun.pisces: Your Sun is in Pisces: you know yourself in sensitivity, imagination and compassion. Music, art, spirituality and feeling other people's suffering come naturally. You are dreamy, selfless and intuitive; failing to keep boundaries and escaping reality are the risks. You are at your best in creative work and helping others with compassion. Your lesson is to tie the dream to daily steps.

moon.aries: Your Moon is in Aries: your feelings are quick, strong and direct. You cannot hide what you feel; anger comes fast and passes fast. You find comfort in movement, activity and independence. What calms you is spending physical energy and making your own decisions. You expect directness and quick answers from those close to you.
moon.taurus: Your Moon is in Taurus: your feelings are steady, slow and deep. You find safety in touch, food, nature and familiar surroundings. Change unsettles you quickly, but once attached you stay loyal for a long time. For comfort you need routine, beautiful things and a quiet home. You expect trust and steadiness from those close to you.
moon.gemini: Your Moon is in Gemini: you process feelings by talking and thinking. To understand a feeling you need to put it into words. Your mood can change quickly; curiosity and novelty support you. For comfort you need conversation, reading and movement. You expect communication and flexibility from those close to you.
moon.cancer: Your Moon is in Cancer (its own sign): your feelings are deep, sensitive and long-remembered. Home, family and memories are your main source of safety. You feel other people's moods and carry them with you. For comfort you need closeness to loved ones and your own nest. You expect warmth and care from those close to you.
moon.leo: Your Moon is in Leo: your feelings are warm, dramatic and generous. Being appreciated, loved and noticed is an emotional need. Creativity and play relax you. Indifference or being put down hurts a lot. You expect respect and open affection from those close to you.
moon.virgo: Your Moon is in Virgo: you analyse feelings and calm down by doing something useful. Worry and self-criticism are the tendency; putting things in order brings comfort. Health, cleanliness and daily routine directly affect your mood. You show care to those close to you through deeds more than words. You expect precision and service in return.
moon.libra: Your Moon is in Libra: you find emotional comfort in harmony, beauty and close relationship. Conflict and tension disturb you greatly; you become the peacemaker. Being alone can be hard because you understand your needs by comparing them with someone else's. You expect courtesy and balance from those close to you.
moon.scorpio: Your Moon is in Scorpio: your feelings are very strong, hidden and deep. Trusting is hard, but once you trust you bind completely. Instead of showing feelings you carry them inside; resentment and jealousy are the risks. For comfort you need honest deep relationship and privacy. You expect complete honesty from those close to you.
moon.sagittarius: Your Moon is in Sagittarius: your feelings are open, optimistic and freedom-loving. When cornered you look for a way out at once; travel, nature and new experiences relax you. Staying with a feeling for long is hard, so you get through it with a philosophical view. You expect freedom and candour from those close to you.
moon.capricorn: Your Moon is in Capricorn: your feelings are controlled, serious and responsible. Showing feeling is hard; from an early age you may have grown used to putting your own needs second. You find safety in order, plans and the results you achieve. You give those close to you practical support. You expect reliability and respect from them.
moon.aquarius: Your Moon is in Aquarius: you look at your feelings from a distance and try to understand them with thought. Independence is an emotional need; too much closeness can feel smothering. Friendship, ideas and groups support you. You expect freedom and open-mindedness from those close to you.
moon.pisces: Your Moon is in Pisces: your feelings are very sensitive, boundless and receptive. You feel other people's moods as your own; when tired you need solitude and daydreaming. Music, water and art calm you. You expect compassion and understanding from those close to you.

asc.aries: Your Ascendant is in Aries: you meet the world as bold, energetic and direct. Your first impression is quick and decisive; you jump straight into new situations. Your body and movement are active. Others take you as someone who leads and says what they think.
asc.taurus: Your Ascendant is in Taurus: you meet the world as calm, steady and reliable. Your first impression is gentle and firm; you do not hurry. Taste shows in voice, dress and movement. Others take you as dependable and practical.
asc.gemini: Your Ascendant is in Gemini: you meet the world as curious, talkative and quick. Your first impression is lively and youthful; hands and eyes speak a lot. You quickly find conversation with new people. Others take you as clever and adaptable.
asc.cancer: Your Ascendant is in Cancer: you meet the world as soft, sensitive and caring. Your first impression is reserved and warm; in a new situation you observe first. Feelings are easy to read on your face. Others take you as protective and sincere.
asc.leo: Your Ascendant is in Leo: you meet the world as confident, warm and eye-catching. Your first impression is bright and generous; you are noticed when you walk into a room. Even your posture and hair stand out. Others take you as a leader and a favourite.
asc.virgo: Your Ascendant is in Virgo: you meet the world as neat, modest and attentive. Your first impression is intelligent and practical; you notice detail at once. Your dress and manner are tidy. Others take you as dependable and helpful.
asc.libra: Your Ascendant is in Libra: you meet the world as courteous, charming and balanced. Your first impression is pleasant and diplomatic; you easily enter contact with people. Aesthetic taste shows in you. Others take you as friendly and fair.
asc.scorpio: Your Ascendant is in Scorpio: you meet the world as mysterious, powerful and composed. Your first impression is intense; your gaze says a lot. You do not open up to people right away. Others take you as deep and perceptive.
asc.sagittarius: Your Ascendant is in Sagittarius: you meet the world as open, optimistic and adventurous. Your first impression is cheerful and frank; you may be tall or broad in movement. You approach new experiences eagerly. Others take you as free-spirited and fun.
asc.capricorn: Your Ascendant is in Capricorn: you meet the world as serious, composed and responsible. Your first impression may be cool but inspires trust; you may seem older than your age. Your goals are clear. Others take you as strong and professional.
asc.aquarius: Your Ascendant is in Aquarius: you meet the world as original, independent and slightly distant. Your first impression is friendly but enigmatic; you have your own style. You are open to new ideas. Others take you as different and interesting.
asc.pisces: Your Ascendant is in Pisces: you meet the world as soft, dreamy and sensitive. Your first impression is gentle and mysterious; the eyes look deep and far. You easily sense the mood around you. Others take you as kind and inspiring.

mercury.aries: Your Mercury is in Aries: you think fast, speak directly and decide without waiting. Debate and new ideas energise you; impatience, half-listening and sharp words are the risks. Your strengths are clarity and initiative.
mercury.taurus: Your Mercury is in Taurus: you think slowly, thoroughly and practically. Before deciding you need to feel and check everything, but your decision holds. Stubbornness and difficulty changing your mind are the risks. Your strength is practical sense.
mercury.gemini: Your Mercury is in its own sign, Gemini: your mind is agile, curious and rich in words. You follow many subjects at once and learn fast. Scatter and superficiality are the risks. Your strengths are communication and adaptability.
mercury.cancer: Your Mercury is in Cancer: your thinking is tied to feeling and memory. You learn best what you listen to, feel and remember; mood affects your thoughts. Taking offence and dwelling on the past are the risks. Your strengths are empathy and a good memory.
mercury.leo: Your Mercury is in Leo: your speech is warm, creative and impressive. You like to stage your ideas and inspire others. Overconfidence and closedness to criticism are the risks. Your strengths are presentation and creative ideas.
mercury.virgo: Your Mercury is in its own sign, Virgo: your mind is analytical, precise and sensitive to detail. You like to systematise, check and be useful. Excessive worry and self-criticism are the risks. Your strengths are precision and practical analysis.
mercury.libra: Your Mercury is in Libra: you see both sides and speak fairly and politely. To decide you need discussion and comparison. Indecision and avoiding conflict are the risks. Your strengths are diplomacy and cooperation.
mercury.scorpio: Your Mercury is in Scorpio: your mind is penetrating, suspicious and investigative. Seeing what is hidden, finding causes and keeping secrets come naturally. Suspicion and harsh words are the risks. Your strengths are research and deep attention.
mercury.sagittarius: Your Mercury is in Sagittarius: you think broadly, generalise and see the big picture. You speak candidly; philosophy, law and foreign subjects attract you. Impatience with detail and hasty words are the risks. Your strengths are a wide view and optimism.
mercury.capricorn: Your Mercury is in Capricorn: your thinking is planned, serious and result-oriented. You organise information and speak with responsibility. Too much seriousness and pessimism are the risks. Your strengths are strategic thinking and organisation.
mercury.aquarius: Your Mercury is in Aquarius: your mind is original, objective and open to novelty. Unusual ideas, science and technology attract you. Stubborn opinions and emotional distance are the risks. Your strengths are a fresh view and independent thinking.
mercury.pisces: Your Mercury is in Pisces: your thinking is intuitive, imagistic and imaginative. You take in information through feeling and images; creative writing and music are close to you. Vagueness and forgetfulness are the risks. Your strengths are intuition and imagination.

venus.aries: Your Venus is in Aries: in love you are bold, direct and the one who pursues. Attraction arises fast and the chase and new beginnings excite you. Impatience and quick cooling are the risks. Your strengths are candour and passion.
venus.taurus: Your Venus is in its own sign, Taurus: love means loyalty, touch and comfort. Beauty, food, music and a steady relationship nourish you. Possessiveness and resisting change are the risks. Your strengths are loyalty and emotional reliability.
venus.gemini: Your Venus is in Gemini: in love, talk, wit and mental attraction matter. Talking to someone who interests you is love; you need variety. Superficiality and avoiding commitment are the risks. Your strengths are lightness and communication.
venus.cancer: Your Venus is in Cancer: love means care, home and emotional safety. You protect and nurture the one you love. Over-sensitivity and clinging are the risks. Your strength is warm, caring love.
venus.leo: Your Venus is in Leo: in love you are generous, dramatic and proud. Attention, praise and romantic gestures matter to you. The need for applause and pride are the risks. Your strengths are a warm heart and loyalty.
venus.virgo: Your Venus is in Virgo: you show love through service, attention and practical care. You are modest, selective and thorough. Over-criticism and perfectionism are the risks. Your strengths are reliability and fine attention.
venus.libra: Your Venus is in its own sign, Libra: love means harmony, partnership and beauty. You are courteous, charming and relationship-oriented. Being alone is hard and avoiding conflict is a risk. Your strengths are taste and balance.
venus.scorpio: Your Venus is in Scorpio: in love you are passionate, deep and all-in. Shallow attachment does not satisfy you; you want full trust and loyalty. Jealousy and control are the risks. Your strengths are deep closeness and fidelity.
venus.sagittarius: Your Venus is in Sagittarius: in love freedom, adventure and shared belief matter. Travelling and learning together bring you close. Avoiding commitment and hasty promises are the risks. Your strengths are candour and optimism.
venus.capricorn: Your Venus is in Capricorn: in love you are serious, loyal and long-term. Opening up takes time, but once attached it lasts a lifetime. Coolness and an eye on status are the risks. Your strengths are reliability and endurance.
venus.aquarius: Your Venus is in Aquarius: in love friendship, independence and shared ideas matter. Unconventional relationships are close to you; you need freedom. Emotional distance and coolness are the risks. Your strengths are friendship and open-mindedness.
venus.pisces: Your Venus is in Pisces (exalted): in love you are compassionate, romantic and self-giving. Unconditional love and spiritual bond are your ideal. Losing boundaries and idealising are the risks. Your strengths are compassion and art.

mars.aries: Your Mars is in its own sign, Aries: your energy is high, brave and direct. You start fast, fight and enjoy competition. Impatience and outbursts of anger are the risks. Your strengths are will and initiative.
mars.taurus: Your Mars is in Taurus: your energy starts slowly but is enduring and determined. You work steadily for a practical result. Stubbornness and anger that comes late but strongly are the risks. Your strengths are endurance and practical power.
mars.gemini: Your Mars is in Gemini: your energy is mental and expressed in words. Debate, planning and doing many things at once suit you. Scatter and sharp words are the risks. Your strengths are flexibility and speed.
mars.cancer: Your Mars is in Cancer (weakened): your energy is tied to feeling and is expressed indirectly. You are strong when protecting loved ones, but direct action is hard. Passive aggression and mood swings are the risks. Your strength is protective energy.
mars.leo: Your Mars is in Leo: your energy is warm, creative and impressive. Leading and being on stage give you strength. Pride and harsh reaction to criticism are the risks. Your strengths are courage and inspiring action.
mars.virgo: Your Mars is in Virgo: your energy is precise, organised and aimed at practical work. Working with detail and putting things in order give you strength. Over-criticism and tension are the risks. Your strengths are efficiency and discipline.
mars.libra: Your Mars is in Libra (weakened): your energy works through partnership and agreement. You avoid direct fighting and act through diplomacy. Indecision and passive aggression are the risks. Your strengths are cooperation and fairness.
mars.scorpio: Your Mars is in Scorpio (an old ruler): your energy is deep, hidden and very strong. You act with determination, strategy and endurance. Control, revenge and hidden anger are the risks. Your strengths are will and perseverance.
mars.sagittarius: Your Mars is in Sagittarius: your energy is freedom-loving, optimistic and adventurous. You act boldly for an ideal and a far goal. Haste and too much risk are the risks. Your strengths are enthusiasm and courage.
mars.capricorn: Your Mars is in Capricorn (exalted): your energy is planned, enduring and goal-driven. You work with discipline for a long-term goal. Rigidity and overwork are the risks. Your strengths are strategic power and endurance.
mars.aquarius: Your Mars is in Aquarius: your energy works for ideas and groups. Questioning rules and acting in new ways suit you. Stubbornness and cold anger are the risks. Your strengths are innovation and defending independence.
mars.pisces: Your Mars is in Pisces: your energy is wave-like, intuitive and indirect. You work selflessly for others but find direct struggle hard. Escapism and loss of energy are the risks. Your strength is compassionate, inspired action.

pair.sun-moon: Sun and Moon: the link between will and feeling, between “what do I want” and “what do I need”. When these two agree there is inner unity; when they do not, inner tug-of-war. This aspect shows the general harmony of the personality.
pair.sun-mercury: Sun and Mercury: the link between identity and thought. It shows how well your ideas fit your personality and how you express yourself in words. Since Mercury stays very close to the Sun, only a conjunction is possible.
pair.sun-venus: Sun and Venus: the link between identity and love and values. It shows how you love yourself, your charm and your sense of beauty. Venus is never more than about 47° from the Sun, so of the major aspects only a conjunction is possible.
pair.sun-mars: Sun and Mars: the link between identity and energy and will. It shows your determination, competitive drive and anger. When harmonious it gives strong will and initiative; when tense, friction and haste.
pair.sun-jupiter: Sun and Jupiter: the link between identity and faith and growth. It shows your optimism, generosity and luck. When harmonious it gives self-belief and opportunity; when tense, excess and over-promising.
pair.sun-saturn: Sun and Saturn: the link between identity and responsibility and limits. It shows self-demand, the influence of the father figure and maturity. When harmonious, discipline and reliability; when tense, self-doubt and a sense of burden.
pair.sun-uranus: Sun and Uranus: the link between identity and freedom and novelty. The theme is being different, independence and sudden change. When harmonious, originality; when tense, instability and rebelliousness.
pair.sun-neptune: Sun and Neptune: the link between identity and dream and spirituality. It shows inspiration, sensitivity and sometimes a hazy sense of self. When harmonious, creativity and compassion; when tense, confusion and escapism.
pair.sun-pluto: Sun and Pluto: the link between identity and power and renewal. It shows strong will, deep crises and rebirth. When harmonious, deep endurance; when tense, control and power struggles.
pair.moon-mercury: Moon and Mercury: the link between feeling and thought. It shows how you put feelings into words and how much your thoughts depend on mood. When harmonious, empathy and a good memory; when tense, mixing feeling and logic.
pair.moon-venus: Moon and Venus: the link between feeling and love. It shows comfort in closeness, taste and emotional needs. When harmonious, a warm, charming nature and harmony in relationships; when tense, too much need or indulgence.
pair.moon-mars: Moon and Mars: the link between feeling and energy. It shows how anger and passion are expressed. When harmonious, vitality and the power to protect; when tense, quick irritation and mood outbursts.
pair.moon-jupiter: Moon and Jupiter: the link between feeling and growth. It shows emotional generosity, optimism and care. When harmonious, largeness of heart and emotional security; when tense, over-feeling and excess.
pair.moon-saturn: Moon and Saturn: the link between feeling and responsibility. It shows holding feelings in, carrying responsibility from an early age and restraint in feeling. When harmonious, emotional stability; when tense, coldness, fear and a sense of loneliness.
pair.moon-uranus: Moon and Uranus: the link between feeling and freedom. It shows changeable moods, a need for independence and unexpected feelings. When harmonious, emotional flexibility; when tense, restlessness and avoiding closeness.
pair.moon-neptune: Moon and Neptune: the link between feeling and dream. It shows strong intuition, empathy and sensitivity to other people's feelings. When harmonious, creativity and compassion; when tense, boundlessness and illusion.
pair.moon-pluto: Moon and Pluto: the link between feeling and depth. It shows strong emotions, attachment and emotional renewal. When harmonious, deep intuition and endurance; when tense, control, jealousy and emotional crises.
pair.mercury-venus: Mercury and Venus: the link between thought and love. It shows pleasant speech, diplomacy and a sense of taste. Both stay close to the Sun, so of the major aspects only a conjunction or a sextile is possible between them.
pair.mercury-mars: Mercury and Mars: the link between thought and energy. It shows a quick mind, a sharp tongue and the power to argue. When harmonious, determined, clear thinking; when tense, harsh words and hasty decisions.
pair.mercury-jupiter: Mercury and Jupiter: the link between thought and growth. It shows a wide view, a love of learning and optimistic thinking. When harmonious, the ability to see the big picture; when tense, over-promising and impatience with detail.
pair.mercury-saturn: Mercury and Saturn: the link between thought and discipline. It shows serious, deep and cautious thinking. When harmonious, a planned, precise mind; when tense, pessimism, self-doubt and difficulty speaking.
pair.mercury-uranus: Mercury and Uranus: the link between thought and novelty. It shows original, quick and unusual ideas. When harmonious, brilliant ideas; when tense, nervousness and unsteady thinking.
pair.mercury-neptune: Mercury and Neptune: the link between thought and dream. It shows intuitive, imagistic and poetic thinking. When harmonious, creative imagination; when tense, vagueness, forgetfulness and misunderstanding.
pair.mercury-pluto: Mercury and Pluto: the link between thought and depth. It shows an investigative, persistent and impressive mind. When harmonious, deep analysis and the power to persuade; when tense, obsessive thought and a tendency to manipulate.
pair.venus-mars: Venus and Mars: the link between love and passion. It shows attraction, romance and sexual energy. When harmonious, strong, harmonious attraction; when tense, tug-of-war in relationships and unsteady passion.
pair.venus-jupiter: Venus and Jupiter: the link between love and abundance. It shows generosity, pleasure, luck and growth in relationships. When harmonious, happiness and material ease; when tense, waste and over-promising.
pair.venus-saturn: Venus and Saturn: the link between love and responsibility. It shows seriousness and loyalty in relationships and difficulty opening up. When harmonious, long-term fidelity; when tense, fear in love and a sense of rejection.
pair.venus-uranus: Venus and Uranus: the link between love and freedom. It shows unusual attraction, sudden love affairs and a need for freedom in closeness. When harmonious, an interesting, independent relationship; when tense, instability and sudden partings.
pair.venus-neptune: Venus and Neptune: the link between love and dream. It shows ideal love, romance and a love of art. When harmonious, compassionate love; when tense, illusion, idealising and being deceived.
pair.venus-pluto: Venus and Pluto: the link between love and deep passion. It shows strong attachment, jealousy and deep change in relationships. When harmonious, deep closeness; when tense, control, obsession and fear of loss.
pair.mars-jupiter: Mars and Jupiter: the link between energy and growth. It shows courage, enthusiasm and movement toward big goals. When harmonious, successful initiative; when tense, too much risk and spreading yourself thin.
pair.mars-saturn: Mars and Saturn: the link between energy and discipline. It shows endurance, planned strength and managing energy. When harmonious, ordered strength; when tense, suppressed anger, a feeling of obstruction and fatigue.
pair.mars-uranus: Mars and Uranus: the link between energy and sudden change. It shows unsteady, strong, jumping energy. When harmonious, pioneering courage; when tense, impulsiveness and accident risk.
pair.mars-neptune: Mars and Neptune: the link between energy and dream. It shows subtle, indirect and inspired action. When harmonious, creative energy; when tense, loss of energy, unclear goals and escapism.
pair.mars-pluto: Mars and Pluto: the link between energy and power. It shows strong will, endurance and great power to change. When harmonious, immense endurance; when tense, power struggles, anger and control.
pair.jupiter-saturn: Jupiter and Saturn: the link between growth and discipline. It shows the balance between optimism and realism and planned expansion. When harmonious, solid, lasting success; when tense, being caught between moving forward and holding back.
pair.jupiter-uranus: Jupiter and Uranus: the link between growth and novelty. It shows sudden opportunities, a search for freedom and different thinking. When harmonious, lucky leaps; when tense, hasty decisions and instability.
pair.jupiter-neptune: Jupiter and Neptune: the link between faith and spirituality. It shows idealism, compassion and spiritual search. When harmonious, deep faith and inspiration; when tense, too much idealism and being deceived.
pair.jupiter-pluto: Jupiter and Pluto: the link between growth and power. It shows great opportunities, influence and deep change of belief. When harmonious, strong success and influence; when tense, a wish for dominance and excess.
pair.saturn-uranus: Saturn and Uranus: the link between order and change. It shows tension between old and new, rule and freedom. When harmonious, controlled innovation; when tense, inner conflict between changing and staying stable.
pair.saturn-neptune: Saturn and Neptune: the link between reality and dream. The theme is making dreams real or sinking into despair before reality. When harmonious, practical inspiration; when tense, fear, doubt and lack of clarity.
pair.saturn-pluto: Saturn and Pluto: the link between structure and deep change. It shows great responsibility, endurance and growing strong through hard lessons. When harmonious, extraordinary endurance; when tense, heavy burden, control and fear.
pair.uranus-neptune: Uranus and Neptune: the link between novelty and dream. It shows a generation's search for spiritual and technological change. It is a long-lasting aspect and carries a generational rather than personal character.
pair.uranus-pluto: Uranus and Pluto: the link between change and renewal. It shows a generation's power of deep social and personal change. It is long-lasting and shared especially by people born in the same years.
pair.neptune-pluto: Neptune and Pluto: the link between dream and deep renewal. It shows a generation's collective unconscious and spiritual change. It is the slowest aspect and a sign of a very long period rather than of the person.

tone.fusion: In a conjunction the two energies cannot separate: you live them together. The strength is that they reinforce each other; the test is that one does not overshadow the other.
tone.easy: This is an easy aspect: the two energies help each other and talent flows with little effort. If you do not develop it, its strength may go unused: make a conscious choice.
tone.hard: This is a hard aspect: there is friction between the two energies. It is difficult, but often this very friction moves you forward: finding a solution that takes both sides into account is the way to grow.

chartRuler.1: The chart ruler sits in the house of the self: identity and life path coincide. Being yourself, taking initiative and starting life on your own steps come naturally. Things often begin from your own impulse, independent of others.
chartRuler.2: The chart ruler is in the house of money and values: your life energy goes into earning, building and deciding what is worth having. Material security and valuing your own talents are central themes. Self-worth and income are linked.
chartRuler.3: The chart ruler is in the house of communication: your life flows through words, learning, writing, short trips and the near environment. Collecting information and passing it on raises your energy. Siblings and neighbours can play an important part.
chartRuler.4: The chart ruler is in the house of home and roots: your energy goes into family, where you live and inner security. Where you feel at home decides everything. The childhood environment and parents keep their influence throughout life.
chartRuler.5: The chart ruler is in the house of creativity: your energy flows through self-expression, romance, play and children. Enjoyment and being on stage give life meaning. Taking risks and living from the heart is your way.
chartRuler.6: The chart ruler is in the house of work and daily routine: your energy goes into service, improvement and health. Being useful and doing the job well gives you meaning. Looking after the body and routine directly decides your quality of life.
chartRuler.7: The chart ruler is in the house of relationships: your life is shaped by partnership, marriage and close collaboration. You get to know yourself through someone else's eyes and the theme of “we” is central. Choosing the right partner changes the life path.
chartRuler.8: The chart ruler is in the house of transformation: your energy goes into deep relationships, shared resources and renewal after crisis. Secrets, intimacy, inheritance and psychological depth are central themes. The biggest changes often come through loss and rebirth.
chartRuler.9: The chart ruler is in the house of outlook: your energy goes into long journeys, education, philosophy and the search for meaning. Anything that widens the world energises you. Experience abroad, law and belief are important parts of the path.
chartRuler.10: The chart ruler is in the house of career: your energy goes into profession, achievement and public standing. Leaving a mark on the world is your life purpose. Career is often the main expression of who you are.
chartRuler.11: The chart ruler is in the house of friends and goals: your energy goes into groups, communities and future ideals. The right circle of people and shared projects carry you forward. People who join your dreams are your main resource.
chartRuler.12: The chart ruler is in the house of the hidden: your energy goes into the inner world, spirituality and work unseen from outside. Solitude and reflection are sources of strength. The life path often becomes clear only with time.

sect.day: This is a day chart: the Sun is above the horizon. Traditionally the Sun, Jupiter and Saturn work better in such a chart, and open, active, conscious energy comes forward. Mars is considered the more difficult planet.
sect.night: This is a night chart: the Sun is below the horizon. Traditionally the Moon, Venus and Mars work better in such a chart, and inward, receptive, sensitive energy comes forward. Saturn is considered the more difficult planet.

half.upper: Most planets are above the horizon (houses 7–12): your life is often directed outward, to the public and to other people. You may be visible, active in society and known by your results.
half.lower: Most planets are below the horizon (houses 1–6): your life is more inward, personal and subjective. Inner development and a close circle matter more to you than outside recognition.
half.east: Most planets are in the eastern half (houses 10–3): you usually steer your own life. Initiative, independence and your own choices matter; rather than waiting for circumstances you create them.
half.west: Most planets are in the western half (houses 4–9): your life is often shaped through other people and circumstances. Cooperation, adapting and responding are your strengths; saying what you want openly is your lesson.

retrograde.mercury: A retrograde Mercury gives a more inward mind: you think first and speak later. Putting thoughts into words may take time, but depth and originality are your strengths.
retrograde.venus: A retrograde Venus means experiencing love and values more deeply and selectively. Finding your own way in relationships and money may take time; shallow attachments do not satisfy you.
retrograde.mars: A retrograde Mars turns energy inward: instead of expressing anger or desire at once you hold it. The way you act is unusual and measured; choosing where to put energy consciously helps.
retrograde.jupiter: A retrograde Jupiter means looking for faith and meaning within. Ready-made beliefs do not satisfy you; you draw your own truth from your own experience.
retrograde.saturn: A retrograde Saturn shows inner responsibility and the limits you set yourself. You test yourself more than outside authorities do; maturity usually arrives later than for others, but more firmly.
retrograde.uranus: A retrograde Uranus shows individuality lived from within: being different shows less outwardly but is strong in your thinking. You experience generational change more inwardly.
retrograde.neptune: A retrograde Neptune shows ideals and intuition that are more personal and inward. You live the dreams of your generation in your own way; the spiritual search is often solitary and deep.
retrograde.pluto: A retrograde Pluto shows deep change happening inside: themes of power and control are inner work more than outer struggle. You go through the generation's transformation on a personal level.

firdaria.sun: The Sun period is one of identity and visibility: expressing yourself, finding your place and gaining standing come forward. Leadership, the theme of the father, self-confidence and life purpose are built in these years. Success usually comes through open, conscious effort.
firdaria.venus: The Venus period is one of love, relationships, pleasure and harmony. Closeness, marriage, art, beauty and material comfort come forward. Relating is easier in these years, but beware of settling into too much ease.
firdaria.mercury: The Mercury period is one of learning, communication, trade and movement. Education, writing, trips, siblings and work with information come forward. The mind is very active; it helps not to scatter attention and to deepen a few things.
firdaria.moon: The Moon period is one of feelings, home, family and change. Roots, themes of the mother, public contacts and mood shift. Events change more often; listening to inner needs is the main support.
firdaria.saturn: The Saturn period is one of responsibility, hard work and maturity. Obligations grow, limits show and delays can happen, but what you build is solid. These years are often remembered later as the most valuable.
firdaria.jupiter: The Jupiter period is one of growth, opportunity and optimism. Education, travel, law, teaching and social expansion come forward. Luck and support come more readily; just avoid over-promising and over-spending.
firdaria.mars: The Mars period is one of energy, action and struggle. Courage, competition, drive toward goals and friction increase. It is a good time to take initiative, and anger is best directed into physical activity and clear goals.
firdaria.northNode: The North Node period is one of growth direction and new encounters. Opportunities from outside, new people and unfamiliar roads come forward. These years often ask “what am I growing toward?”
firdaria.southNode: The South Node period is one of letting go and closing. Old habits, past relationships and what no longer serves come into view. It can look like loss, but it makes room for a new stage.

dasha.ketu: The Ketu period (7 years) is one of detachment, spiritual search and letting go. Interest in material goals may fade while the pull toward the inner world and meaning grows. Sudden changes and losses are possible; freeing yourself from habits is the main lesson.
