dasha.venus: The Venus period (20 years) is the longest: love, relationships, art, comfort and material means. Pleasure and beauty come forward and it becomes possible to build a family and shape values. Too much comfort and dependence are the danger.
dasha.sun: The Sun period (6 years) is one of identity, standing and career. Leadership, work with authority, the father and health come forward. A short but decisive period: expressing yourself and setting goals matter.
dasha.moon: The Moon period (10 years) is one of feelings, home and family. Mood, the mother, where you live and public contacts come forward. Mood may be changeable; building inner stability is the main task.
dasha.mars: The Mars period (7 years) is one of energy, property and action. Courage, competition, real estate and siblings come forward. It is a time of strong progress, but haste and friction also grow.
dasha.rahu: The Rahu period (18 years) is one of ambition, unconventional paths and new fields. Foreign lands, technology, fame and unusual encounters come forward. Great progress or deception is possible; checked facts help.
dasha.jupiter: The Jupiter period (16 years) is one of wisdom, growth and support. Education, teaching, children, law and spiritual growth come forward. These years are often counted as the most fortunate; expansion needs to be joined with order.
dasha.saturn: The Saturn period (19 years) is one of discipline, hard work and responsibility. Career building, obligations and maturity come forward. Delays and heaviness are possible, but what is built patiently lasts a lifetime.
dasha.mercury: The Mercury period (17 years) is one of mind, communication and trade. Education, business, writing and new skills come forward. Flexibility and the ability to learn grow; not scattering matters.

shape.bundle: Bundle: all the planets are gathered within 120°. This gives a narrow, focused and self-contained character: great depth in a few themes, but perhaps less breadth of experience. The empty parts are often areas to learn from other people.
shape.bowl: Bowl: all the planets are in half the circle, within 180°. The empty half shows the area you have to meet in life, the full half your natural strength. A sense of inner wholeness and of something to be filled is common.
shape.bucket: Bucket: most planets form a bowl and one planet stands alone opposite it as the handle. The handle planet is the outlet of the chart's energy: attention is drawn to it, and it can become the main purpose of life.
shape.locomotive: Locomotive: the planets are spread evenly over 240° with one empty trine of signs. It gives movement, drive and progress toward a goal; the missing part is often felt as an inner push. The person is active but has to learn to rest.
shape.seesaw: Seesaw: the planets form two groups with two wide gaps between them. Life is often lived as a search for balance between two poles: work and family, inner and outer, self and other. Seeing both sides is a strength, deciding can be hard.
shape.splash: Splash: the planets are spread evenly around the whole circle with no large gap. It gives many-sided interests, wide experience and adaptability; the risk is scatter and difficulty going deep into one theme.
shape.splay: Splay: the planets gather in three or more clusters with no regular pattern. It gives an individual, unusual character that does not fit rules: you choose your own way. Each cluster is a life theme of its own.

temperament.choleric: Choleric (fire): energetic, determined, enterprising and demanding. Decides quickly, likes a contest and leans toward leadership. The weakness is impatience and anger; action, goals and competition give strength.
temperament.sanguine: Sanguine (air): sociable, optimistic, flexible and curious. Moves easily among people and ideas and likes novelty. The weakness is superficiality and inconsistency; conversation, variety and a social setting give strength.
temperament.melancholic: Melancholic (earth): serious, deep, responsible and precise. Thinks everything over, makes long-term plans. The weakness is pessimism and over-worry; order, practical work and stability give strength.
temperament.phlegmatic: Phlegmatic (water): calm, sensitive, patient and caring. Does not hurry and attends to feelings and those around. The weakness is passivity and withdrawal; comfort, close people and the inner world give strength.

critical.anaretic: Anaretic degree (29°): the planet is in the last degree of the sign. The theme is lived as completion and urgency: finishing the sign's lesson, often with tension and great attention. It is often felt as early maturity or an important but hard lesson.
critical.critical: Critical degree: the planet is at a degree counted critical for the sign's modality (cardinal 0°, 13°, 26°; fixed 9°, 21°; mutable 4°, 17°). Traditionally such a planet is considered more emphasised and unstable: the theme comes forward and brings decisive moments.

dispositor.final: The final dispositor is the planet at the end of every chain: it is in its own sign and the other planets answer to it. Its themes work as the “chief executive” of the chart, and its condition sets the ease of the whole chart.
dispositor.reception: Mutual reception: two planets stand in each other's signs. They support each other and cooperate as if by exchanging places: the theme of one is expressed through the other. It softens even hard aspects.
dispositor.loop: Loop: the planets rule each other in a chain and it does not stop at one planet. Such a chart has no single chief: these planets work together and one theme passes to the next. It can give inner many-voicedness or a sense of interdependence.

mc.aries: Your Midheaven is in Aries: in your career you want to be a pioneer, competitive and independent. Starting new things, showing initiative and being first drive you; working long under someone else's orders may be hard. Entrepreneurship, sales, sport, the military or professions needing quick decisions suit you.
mc.taurus: Your Midheaven is in Taurus: in your career you look for stability, quality and material results. You advance slowly but solidly; work that creates pleasure, beauty and practical value suits you. Finance, land and property, crafts, food and aesthetics are usual choices. Change comes late, but what you build lasts.
mc.gemini: Your Midheaven is in Gemini: in your career words, information and contacts are your tools. You are flexible, many-sided and open to learning; writing, journalism, education, trade, technology and communication suit you. You may hold several jobs or paths at once; to go deep you need to stay in one direction.
mc.cancer: Your Midheaven is in Cancer: in your career care, protection and support for people are central. Work with family, home, food, medicine, psychology, education and children suits you; in a team you may play the parent. Public recognition comes through emotional bonds; over-sensitivity and taking criticism hard are the risks.
mc.leo: Your Midheaven is in Leo: in your career you want to be seen, to create and to inspire others. Leadership, the arts, the stage, management, children and entertainment suit you. Recognition and respect matter to you; you bear unseen, anonymous work poorly. You can be a generous leader.
mc.virgo: Your Midheaven is in Virgo: in your career precision, analysis and being useful are your strengths. Medicine, health, accounting, editing, research, technical and service fields suit you. Attention to detail and quality makes you a valued specialist; perfectionism and self-criticism are the risks.
mc.libra: Your Midheaven is in Libra: in your career partnership, diplomacy and fairness come forward. Law, diplomacy, design, fashion, the arts, counselling and working with people suit you. You work well in teams and pairs; deciding alone and avoiding conflict can be hard.
mc.scorpio: Your Midheaven is in Scorpio: in your career depth, investigation and transformation attract you. Psychology, research, investigation, finance, surgery, crisis management or work with hidden knowledge suit you. You are strong, strategic and determined; control and power struggles are the risks.
mc.sagittarius: Your Midheaven is in Sagittarius: in your career freedom, wide horizons and the search for meaning matter. Education, law, publishing, travel, foreign relations, philosophy or religion suit you. You love independence and bear a narrow, repetitive job poorly. You see the big picture; detail may be a weakness.
mc.capricorn: Your Midheaven is in its own sign, Capricorn: career is a main theme of your life. You are purposeful, disciplined and think long term; leadership, management, government, engineering, business or industry suit you. Respect and achievement matter; do not let work overshadow everything else.
mc.aquarius: Your Midheaven is in Aquarius: in your career innovation, technology and service to society attract you. Science, programming, innovation, social projects, non-profit and group work suit you. You tend to choose an unconventional path and to work independently; fitting into hierarchy and rules can be hard.
mc.pisces: Your Midheaven is in Pisces: in your career creativity, compassion and the search for spiritual meaning come forward. The arts, music, film, healing and helping professions, spiritual work or water-related fields suit you. Your career path may not be clear at first; keeping boundaries and not forgetting the practical side matters.

ruler.1: The career ruler is in the 1st house: your profession coincides with your personality. You make your career yourself and become known under your own name. Working independently or being the “face” of the work often suits you.
ruler.2: The career ruler is in the 2nd house: career is tied to money, talent and earnings. Building material stability from your work and turning your skills into money come first. Finance, trade or craft fields may suit you.
ruler.3: The career ruler is in the 3rd house: the profession involves communication, writing, education or transport. Exchanging information and ideas is your work. Siblings, neighbours and the near environment may play a part in your career.
ruler.4: The career ruler is in the 4th house: work is tied to home, family, real estate or roots. Working from home, a family business or service to the homeland may suit you. Inner security strongly affects career choice.
ruler.5: The career ruler is in the 5th house: the profession involves creativity, art, entertainment, children or risk-taking. Work in which you express yourself gives you strength. The stage, education, sport or investment may suit you.
ruler.6: The career ruler is in the 6th house: the profession involves service, health, daily work and detailed work. Giving others practical help gives you meaning. Medicine, technical or administrative fields suit you; not being absorbed by work matters.
ruler.7: The career ruler is in the 7th house: career is tied to partnership, clients and the public. Joint ventures, counselling, law or diplomacy suit you. Career is often built through another person.
ruler.8: The career ruler is in the 8th house: the profession is tied to shared money, finance, research or crisis fields. Banks, insurance, tax, psychology, medicine or work with hidden knowledge suit you. Big changes and fresh starts may come in your career.
ruler.9: The career ruler is in the 9th house: the profession involves education, law, publishing, travel or foreign contacts. Teaching, translation, international work and philosophical fields suit you. Career often expands away from the place of birth.
ruler.10: The career ruler is in its own house, the 10th: career is the centre of your life and gives a clear direction. Public standing and authority are a strong motive. Leadership and responsibility often come naturally.
ruler.11: The career ruler is in the 11th house: career is tied to friends, networks, groups and future projects. Teamwork, community, technology and social initiatives suit you. Contacts and recommendations carry your career forward.
ruler.12: The career ruler is in the 12th house: career is less visible from outside and may be behind the scenes, solitary or service-oriented. Research, healing, spiritual fields, hospitals or charity suit you. Recognition may come late or indirectly.

planet.sun: The Sun in career: recognition, leadership and choosing your own road. The Sun's condition shows how much you want to be seen and to hold authority at work.
planet.moon: The Moon in career: working with people, public contact, care and flexibility. The Moon's condition tells about emotional changeability in career and the relation with the public.
planet.mercury: Mercury in career: communication, trade, analysis, writing and negotiation. Mercury's condition shows how thinking and presentation work in your career.
planet.venus: Venus in career: beauty, diplomacy, working relationships and income. Venus's condition shows charm, taste and the ability to reach agreement at work.
planet.mars: Mars in career: energy, competition, initiative and technical skill. Mars's condition shows how driven you are at work and how you handle competition.
planet.jupiter: Jupiter in career: growth, luck, teaching and expansion. Jupiter's condition shows how easily opportunities open in career and where success comes.
planet.saturn: Saturn in career: structure, responsibility, authority and long-term results. Saturn's condition shows which difficulties you must overcome in career and what you can build solidly over time.

cusp.aries: The 2nd house cusp is Aries: you earn money fast and spend it fast. Initiative, enterprise and work of your own bring income. Hasty spending and risk are the dangers; you need a rule that protects your income.
cusp.taurus: The 2nd house cusp is Taurus (its own house): money is safety and comfort for you. You build slowly, steadily and by saving; land, property and quality things hold value. Thrift is a strength, too much possessiveness a weakness.
cusp.gemini: The 2nd house cusp is Gemini: income comes from words, trade, writing and several sources. Income is flexible and can vary. It helps to strengthen one or two main sources instead of several half-jobs.
cusp.cancer: The 2nd house cusp is Cancer: money means family and emotional security. Building earnings through home, food, care and real estate suits you. Mood affects spending; emotional shopping is the risk.
cusp.leo: The 2nd house cusp is Leo: you spend money generously and earn through creativity, leadership and visibility. Quality and beautiful things attract you. Spending for status is the risk; tie earnings to a long-term plan.
cusp.virgo: The 2nd house cusp is Virgo: you are precise, thrifty and practical with money. Income comes through service, analysis and detailed work. Budgeting comes naturally; excessive worry and self-criticism are the risks.
cusp.libra: The 2nd house cusp is Libra: money comes through partnership, beauty and harmony. Design, law, diplomacy and joint ventures bring earnings. Spending on taste and relationships can be high; keeping balance with a budget matters.
cusp.scorpio: The 2nd house cusp is Scorpio: you are deep, strategic and private about money. Income comes through finance, research, restructuring and shared resources. Power and control are tied to money; there may be periods of big gain and big loss.
cusp.sagittarius: The 2nd house cusp is Sagittarius: money comes through expansion, travel, education and optimism. You are generous and sometimes overspend. Income from abroad or from teaching is possible; spending discipline is needed.
cusp.capricorn: The 2nd house cusp is Capricorn: money is hard work, responsibility and long-term structure. Income grows gradually, with discipline and career. You are thrifty and careful; taking money too seriously and forgetting to spend on yourself are the risks.
cusp.aquarius: The 2nd house cusp is Aquarius: income comes through unconventional ways, technology, networks and innovation. Your relation to money can be independent and unstable. Diversifying sources of income is good.
cusp.pisces: The 2nd house cusp is Pisces: money is fluid, intuitive and sometimes vague. Income can come through creativity, healing, the arts or helping others. Setting clear boundaries and guarding against debt and being deceived matter.

ruler.1: The finance ruler is in the 1st house: money and identity are linked. Income comes through your personal initiative, skill and appearance. Investing in yourself is the best return.
ruler.2: The finance ruler is in its own house, the 2nd: money is a main theme of life. There is a strong natural capacity to build and manage your own income. Self-worth and income are linked.
ruler.3: The finance ruler is in the 3rd house: income is tied to communication, trade, writing, education and short trips. Information and contacts turn into money. Siblings and neighbours may play a part in finances.
ruler.4: The finance ruler is in the 4th house: money is tied to home, family, real estate and inheritance. Support through family or income from property is possible. Material security is inseparable from home security.
ruler.5: The finance ruler is in the 5th house: income is tied to creativity, entertainment, investment and children. Risk-taking and spending for pleasure are possible. Creative work or careful investment brings income.
ruler.6: The finance ruler is in the 6th house: income is tied to daily work, service and health. A salary or service income is steady. Health spending and earnings from work are linked.
ruler.7: The finance ruler is in the 7th house: money is tied to partnership, clients and joint ventures. Income and spending may be shared with a partner. Choosing the right partner decides the financial result.
ruler.8: The finance ruler is in the 8th house: money is tied to shared resources, debts, inheritance, insurance and other people's money. Big changes and fresh starts may come. Financial order and openness matter.
ruler.9: The finance ruler is in the 9th house: income is tied to education, law, publishing, travel and foreign contacts. Earnings from abroad or from teaching are possible. A wide view is an advantage in finances.
ruler.10: The finance ruler is in the 10th house: money is tied to career, standing and public position. Income grows with professional achievement. Authority and money feed each other.
ruler.11: The finance ruler is in the 11th house: income is tied to networks, friends, groups and long-term projects. Gains through contacts are possible. Shared goals increase financial possibilities.
ruler.12: The finance ruler is in the 12th house: money is tied to hidden costs, losses or work unseen from outside. Charity, healing or behind-the-scenes work may bring income. Keeping finances transparent and watching hidden costs matter.

fortune.1: The Part of Fortune is in the 1st house: success and ease come from your own initiative, appearance and self-expression. Things go easily where you are yourself.
fortune.2: The Part of Fortune is in the 2nd house: traditionally the strongest place for material success. Ease comes through earnings, skills and your own resources.
fortune.3: The Part of Fortune is in the 3rd house: luck comes from communication, learning, writing and the near environment. The right word and contact open opportunities.
fortune.4: The Part of Fortune is in the 4th house: ease comes from home, family, roots and real estate. The later years of life are often more fortunate.
fortune.5: The Part of Fortune is in the 5th house: success comes from creativity, romance, children and work you enjoy. Playing and creating may bring you money.
fortune.6: The Part of Fortune is in the 6th house: ease comes from daily work, service, health and good habits. Order and being useful bring you success.
fortune.7: The Part of Fortune is in the 7th house: success comes from partnership, marriage and cooperation. Things go more easily together with the right person.
fortune.8: The Part of Fortune is in the 8th house: luck comes from shared resources, inheritance, insurance and deep change. Other people's money and renewal create opportunity.
fortune.9: The Part of Fortune is in the 9th house: success comes from education, travel, law and foreign contacts. Luck grows as you widen your world.
fortune.10: The Part of Fortune is in the 10th house: success comes from career, public standing and achievement. Recognition in your profession brings both ease and material means.
fortune.11: The Part of Fortune is in the 11th house: luck comes from friends, networks and shared goals. The right circle of people opens doors.
fortune.12: The Part of Fortune is in the 12th house: ease comes from solitude, inner work, service and spiritual fields. Luck often comes out of sight, by an indirect route.

planet.venus: Venus in money: income, values and pleasure. Venus's condition shows what you value, how you relate to money and how you enjoy spending.
planet.jupiter: Jupiter in money: abundance, luck and growth. Jupiter's condition shows how easily material opportunities open and when you go to excess.
planet.saturn: Saturn in money: thrift, limits and long-term structure. Saturn's condition shows how much work material security takes and what you can accumulate over time.
planet.mercury: Mercury in money: trade, calculation and contracts. Mercury's condition shows your skill in buying and selling, negotiating and handling documents.
planet.mars: Mars in money: spending, risk and fighting for earnings. Mars's condition shows how driven you are for money and your tendency to impulsive spending.

asc.aries: The Ascendant is in Aries: traditionally the head, face and eyes are tied to this sign. Your energy is high and quick, but too much tension may show as headaches, strain and a tendency to accidents. Movement and physical activity keep you well.
asc.taurus: The Ascendant is in Taurus: traditionally the neck, throat and voice are tied to this sign. You have a steady, enduring body; too much comfort, food and inactivity can raise weight. A regular routine and walks in nature help.
asc.gemini: The Ascendant is in Gemini: traditionally the arms, hands, lungs and nervous system are tied to this sign. Mental activity is high; restlessness, disturbed sleep and nervous fatigue are the risks. Breathing exercises and mental rest help.
asc.cancer: The Ascendant is in Cancer: traditionally the chest, stomach and breasts are tied to this sign. Your body is very sensitive to feelings; stress may show as digestive discomfort. Emotional comfort and good nutrition are the basis of health.
asc.leo: The Ascendant is in Leo: traditionally the heart, back and spine are tied to this sign. You have strong vitality; overload and stress may affect the cardiovascular system. Good posture, rest and heartfelt enjoyment help.
asc.virgo: The Ascendant is in Virgo: traditionally the digestive system and intestines are tied to this sign. Your body is very sensitive to food and routine; worry may show as digestive trouble. Simple, clean food and daily order are the main support.
asc.libra: The Ascendant is in Libra: traditionally the kidneys, lower back and skin are tied to this sign. The body wants balance and comfort; conflict and lost balance lower your energy. Enough water and a harmonious setting help.
asc.scorpio: The Ascendant is in Scorpio: traditionally the reproductive and excretory organs are tied to this sign. Your body has a deep power of recovery; suppressed feelings and stress may build up in the body. Expressing feelings and physical release are important.
asc.sagittarius: The Ascendant is in Sagittarius: traditionally the hips, thighs and liver are tied to this sign. You need movement and open air; excess (food, drink, load) is the risk. A moderate lifestyle and long walks help.
asc.capricorn: The Ascendant is in Capricorn: traditionally the bones, joints, knees and skin are tied to this sign. Your body is enduring but may be sensitive to cold and stiffness; heavy workload affects the joints. Warmth, stretching and rest are important.
asc.aquarius: The Ascendant is in Aquarius: traditionally the ankles, calves and circulation are tied to this sign. The body can be unsteady; sedentary work worsens circulation. Movement, resting the legs and a regular routine help.
asc.pisces: The Ascendant is in Pisces: traditionally the feet, lymph and immune system are tied to this sign. Your body is very sensitive to surroundings; tiredness and energy swings may occur. Enough sleep, water and moments of solitude restore you.

cusp.aries: The 6th house cusp is Aries: illnesses start quickly and pass quickly; inflammation, fever and a tendency to accidents are traditionally tied to this. Movement and active work are important in the daily routine.
cusp.taurus: The 6th house cusp is Taurus: health depends on routine, food and a comfortable setting. The throat and neck may be sensitive; slow, lingering complaints are possible. Steady daily habits are the basis.
cusp.gemini: The 6th house cusp is Gemini: health depends on breathing, the nervous system and mental load. With a heavy workload fatigue and sleep problems may occur. Breaks and breathing exercises help.
cusp.cancer: The 6th house cusp is Cancer: health is tied to feelings and digestion. Stress affects the stomach; comfort at home and food are the most important part of health.
cusp.leo: The 6th house cusp is Leo: health is tied to the heart, spine and vitality. Good mood and creativity support health; overload affects the heart.
cusp.virgo: The 6th house cusp is Virgo (its own house): health is a very important theme for you. Digestion, food, cleanliness and routine play the main part; worry affects the body. Systematic daily care is the best medicine.
cusp.libra: The 6th house cusp is Libra: health is tied to balance, the kidneys and the skin. If there is no harmony in the work setting the body feels it. Enough water and a peaceful working setting are important.
cusp.scorpio: The 6th house cusp is Scorpio: health is tied to deep recovery power and hidden tension. Hidden fatigue and the hormonal and excretory systems need attention. Releasing feelings and renewal are important.
cusp.sagittarius: The 6th house cusp is Sagittarius: health depends on movement, open air and moderation. The liver and hips may be sensitive; excess of food, drink and load is the risk.
cusp.capricorn: The 6th house cusp is Capricorn: health is tied to discipline. Bones, joints and skin need attention; too much load at work may cause chronic fatigue. Plan rest as well.
cusp.aquarius: The 6th house cusp is Aquarius: health is tied to circulation and the nervous system. An unusual work schedule and a sedentary life may cause trouble. Find a different but regular routine.
cusp.pisces: The 6th house cusp is Pisces: health is tied to sensitivity, immunity and tiredness. Surroundings affect the body strongly; enough sleep, water and a quiet working setting are important. It is good to have vague complaints checked.

ruler.1: The ruler of the 6th is in the 1st house: health is bound up with your personality. The body responds to everything at once; you know your body well. Looking after yourself should be at the centre of your lifestyle.
ruler.2: The ruler of the 6th is in the 2nd house: health and material situation are linked. Food, bodily resources and care according to income matter. Investing in health brings a long-term return.
ruler.3: The ruler of the 6th is in the 3rd house: health is tied to breathing, the nervous system and daily movement. Mental load and too much information cause fatigue. The people near you affect your routine.
ruler.4: The ruler of the 6th is in the 4th house: health is tied to the home setting, family and emotional security. Comfort at home and nutrition are the basis. Family health patterns may affect you.
ruler.5: The ruler of the 6th is in the 5th house: health is tied to pleasure, creativity and heart energy. Play and enjoyment heal you; be careful with excess and risky pursuits.
ruler.6: The ruler of the 6th is in its own house: health and daily routine are a main theme of your life. Work and care of the body often blend. A systematic routine is a strong support; being absorbed by work is the risk.
ruler.7: The ruler of the 6th is in the 7th house: health is affected by relationships. A partner's routine and mood pass to you. Healthy habits together are the best support.
ruler.8: The ruler of the 6th is in the 8th house: the health theme is tied to deep change and recovery. Stress and built-up tension can leave a deep mark on the body. Take recovery periods seriously and have checks on time.
ruler.9: The ruler of the 6th is in the 9th house: health is tied to travel, open air and a wide outlook. Beliefs and philosophy about health matter to you. Watch routine and food when travelling.
ruler.10: The ruler of the 6th is in the 10th house: health is directly tied to career and workload. Professional stress passes to the body; balance between work and rest is important. The profession affects health, or health may turn into a profession.
ruler.11: The ruler of the 6th is in the 11th house: health is tied to friends and groups. Sport together and community support help. The social setting shapes your habits.
ruler.12: The ruler of the 6th is in the 12th house: the health theme is tied to hidden fatigue, sleep and the inner world. Complaints may be hard to pin down; solitary rest and sleep restore. It is important to have vague complaints checked.

planet.sun: The Sun in health: vitality and life force. The Sun's condition shows your general strength, its links with the heart and spine, and what you draw energy from.
planet.moon: The Moon in health: feelings, sleep, fluids and daily rhythm. The Moon's condition shows mood swings, digestion and how sensitive the body is to rhythm.
planet.mercury: Mercury in health: the nervous system, breathing and mental load. Mercury's condition shows how worry, sleep and information overload affect the body.
planet.mars: Mars in health: energy, inflammation and accidents. Mars's condition shows your physical strength, the effect of anger on the body and care in risky situations.
planet.saturn: Saturn in health: bones, joints and chronic fatigue. Saturn's condition shows endurance, the body's sensitivity to cold and load, and changes that come with time.

sign.aries: Saturn in Aries is in its fall: initiative, courage and breaking your own path are a hard lesson here. Confidence comes late, but when it comes it is unshakable.
sign.taurus: Saturn in Taurus gives patient lessons about security, money and the body. What is built slowly here lasts.
sign.gemini: Saturn in Gemini asks for discipline in thought, speech and learning. It gives serious, deep thinking and teaches you to hold back instead of rushing to speak.
sign.cancer: Saturn in Cancer is in detriment: family, home and emotional security can feel cold or heavy. The lesson is to build your own shelter.
sign.leo: Saturn in Leo is in detriment: holding back, or pressure to prove yourself, around being loved, creating and being seen. The lesson is to shine without waiting for approval.
sign.virgo: Saturn in Virgo gives a steady craft in work, service and daily order. Perfectionism and harsh self-criticism are the main risks.
sign.libra: Saturn in Libra is exalted: it brings maturity to relationships, fairness and commitments. It helps build unions that come late but last.
sign.scorpio: Saturn in Scorpio teaches control over feelings, power and shared resources. Facing deep fears gives a serious foundation in the end.
sign.sagittarius: Saturn in Sagittarius tests faith, law and worldview. It asks you to build truths you have tested yourself, not ready-made beliefs.
sign.capricorn: Saturn in Capricorn is at home: responsibility, achievement and structure work as natural strengths. The risk is leaving no room for anything but work.
sign.aquarius: Saturn in Aquarius is at home: a cool but fair view of collective rules, friendship and public duty. It teaches you to pay the price of being different.
sign.pisces: Saturn in Pisces teaches boundaries piece by piece among dreams, compassion and escape. The lesson is to give help with measure, not without limits.

house.1: Saturn in the 1st house: feeling serious and burdened, early responsibility. Over time it builds a strong personality and authority.
house.2: Saturn in the 2nd house: money and a sense of worth are earned hard and teach thrift. Material stability comes late but firm.
house.3: Saturn in the 3rd house: seriousness and difficulty in communication, study and with siblings. The weight of your word grows.
house.4: Saturn in the 4th house: coldness, a sense of debt or a heavy atmosphere at home. The adult lesson is to build your own home and roots consciously.
house.5: Saturn in the 5th house: tension or delay around joy, creativity and children. The lesson is to allow yourself play and pleasure.
house.6: Saturn in the 6th house: a heavy workload and a need for routine for health. When discipline is built, body and work steady.
house.7: Saturn in the 7th house: entering relationships late and seriously, fear of commitment or older, responsible partners. Unions become reliable with time.
house.8: Saturn in the 8th house: caution or fear around intimacy, power, inheritance and shared money. Deep trust is built slowly.
house.9: Saturn in the 9th house: doubt in belief, higher study and travel, or building your own strict rules. Mastery and your own truth arrive in maturity.
house.10: Saturn in the 10th house: high aims, serious work in the career and late recognition. The peak is hard but lasting; authority also brings duty.
house.11: Saturn in the 11th house: being selective with friends, taking hopes seriously. Few but loyal friends and long-term goals.
house.12: Saturn in the 12th house: hidden fears, loneliness and self-imposed burdens. If solitude and silence are chosen consciously, they give deep inner strength.

saturn.retro: Saturn is retrograde: a lesson turned inward that asks for inner responsibility. The rules are to be built by you, not from the outside.

sign.aries: Pluto in Aries: the shared theme of the generation is personal will, new beginnings and bold change. The personal effect depends on the house.
sign.taurus: Pluto in Taurus: the shared theme of the generation is a deep change in money, land, security and values.
sign.gemini: Pluto in Gemini: the shared theme of the generation is the change of information, language and the exchange of ideas.
sign.cancer: Pluto in Cancer: the shared theme of the generation is the rebuilding of family, homeland and security.
sign.leo: Pluto in Leo: the shared theme of the generation is personal expression, creativity and a redefinition of power.
sign.virgo: Pluto in Virgo: the shared theme of the generation is the rebuilding of work, service, health and daily life.
sign.libra: Pluto in Libra: the shared theme of the generation is a change in relationships, justice and partnerships.
sign.scorpio: Pluto in Scorpio is at home: the shared theme of the generation is power, secrets, death and rebirth and shared resources. Depth is natural here.
sign.sagittarius: Pluto in Sagittarius: the shared theme of the generation is a change in belief, religion, law and worldview.
sign.capricorn: Pluto in Capricorn: the shared theme of the generation is power, the state, and the collapse and rebuilding of structures.
sign.aquarius: Pluto in Aquarius: the shared theme of the generation is society, technology and a shift in collective power.
sign.pisces: Pluto in Pisces: the shared theme of the generation is spirituality, dreams and the dissolving of boundaries.

house.1: Pluto in the 1st house: a strong, intense personality; recreating yourself several times in life. Others feel your power.
house.2: Pluto in the 2nd house: deep changes in money, possessions and sense of worth; losing and rebuilding. Power is tied to material security.
house.3: Pluto in the 3rd house: power of influence in thought and speech; intensity in communication and deep events with siblings.
house.4: Pluto in the 4th house: hidden power struggles in the family, deep root themes. A serious cleansing around home and the past.
house.5: Pluto in the 5th house: intense, possibly obsessive experiences in love, creativity and with children. A creative rebirth.
house.6: Pluto in the 6th house: a deep rebuilding of work and health; themes of control and purging at work.
house.7: Pluto in the 7th house: intense relationships, themes of power and control. Deep change through the partner.
house.8: Pluto in the 8th house: strong, as at home: intimacy, inheritance, crisis and rebirth. The power to handle secrets and deep feelings.
house.9: Pluto in the 9th house: a deep change in belief and worldview; change through long journeys or study.
house.10: Pluto in the 10th house: power, control and turning points in the career and public role. Great influence, but struggles too.
house.11: Pluto in the 11th house: power and change in friendships and groups; a wish to influence society.
house.12: Pluto in the 12th house: hidden, subconscious power; deep inner transformations. Great change in solitude and silence.

pluto.retro: Pluto is retrograde: the process of change happens more inside than outside. Power is to be understood within before it is expressed.

uranus.aries: Uranus in Aries: the shared theme of the generation is bold beginnings, individual freedom and initiative. Those who take the first step bring the new.
uranus.taurus: Uranus in Taurus: the shared theme of the generation is the renewal of money, land, food and values. What was thought steady is shaken.
uranus.gemini: Uranus in Gemini: the shared theme of the generation is new forms of information, communication and learning. Ideas change fast.
uranus.cancer: Uranus in Cancer: the shared theme of the generation is rethinking family, home and the idea of security.
uranus.leo: Uranus in Leo: the shared theme of the generation is individual expression, creativity and new paths to recognition. Everyone wants to be one of a kind.
uranus.virgo: Uranus in Virgo: the shared theme of the generation is the renewal of work, technique and daily life, and a rebuilding of efficiency.
uranus.libra: Uranus in Libra: the shared theme of the generation is relationships, marriage and social rules moving into new forms.
uranus.scorpio: Uranus in Scorpio: the shared theme of the generation is power, intimacy and the surfacing of what is hidden. Deep and sudden change.
uranus.sagittarius: Uranus in Sagittarius: the shared theme of the generation is belief, travel and a widening worldview. Borders open.
uranus.capricorn: Uranus in Capricorn: the shared theme of the generation is power, institutions and the rebuilding of traditional structures.
uranus.aquarius: Uranus in Aquarius is at home: the shared theme of the generation is technology, society and collective freedom. The new arrives as a natural flow.
uranus.pisces: Uranus in Pisces: the shared theme of the generation is spirituality, imagination and the dissolving of boundaries. New forms of feeling and awareness.

neptune.aries: Neptune in Aries: the shared dream of the generation is personal courage, heroism and a new start. The risk is hasty action for an ideal.
neptune.taurus: Neptune in Taurus: the shared dream of the generation is material comfort, beauty and closeness to nature. The risk is illusion about money and things.
neptune.gemini: Neptune in Gemini: the shared dream of the generation is the magic of the word, information and communication. The risk is truth mixing with falsehood.
neptune.cancer: Neptune in Cancer: the shared dream of the generation is family, homeland and care. The risk is too much nostalgia for the past.
neptune.leo: Neptune in Leo: the shared dream of the generation is fame, creativity and romantic ideals. The risk is being fooled by glitter.
neptune.virgo: Neptune in Virgo: the shared dream of the generation is service, health and perfect work. The risk is vagueness and confusion through criticism.
neptune.libra: Neptune in Libra: the shared dream of the generation is ideal love, justice and harmony. The risk is illusion about relationships.
neptune.scorpio: Neptune in Scorpio: the shared dream of the generation is deep intimacy, mystery and a spiritual turn. The risk is hidden or compulsive bonds.
neptune.sagittarius: Neptune in Sagittarius: the shared dream of the generation is distant ideals, faith and free travel. The risk is blind belief.
neptune.capricorn: Neptune in Capricorn: the shared dream of the generation is faith in structure, achievement and authority. The risk is trusting institutions too much and then being disappointed.
neptune.aquarius: Neptune in Aquarius: the shared dream of the generation is universal ideals, technology and togetherness. The risk is the individual disappearing in the collective.
neptune.pisces: Neptune in Pisces is at home: the shared dream of the generation is spirituality, compassion and unity. The risk is escape from reality.

role.jupiter: Jupiter: expansion, faith, economic growth, education and law. It shows the general mood of the year and what society places its hopes in.
role.saturn: Saturn: rules, responsibility, limits and institutions. It shows where society tightens and what it has to rebuild.
role.uranus: Uranus: sudden change, technology, freedom and revolt. It shows where old systems crack.
role.neptune: Neptune: ideals, dreams, spirituality, media and illusion. It shows what society believes in and where it loses its bearings.
role.pluto: Pluto: deep transformation, power and the surfacing of what was hidden. It shows the theme of long, irreversible change.
role.northNode: The North Node: the collective direction of growth. It shows the theme society is moving toward, while the South Node shows what it is moving away from.

areas.taurus: money, land, food, resources and values
areas.cancer: family, home, homeland and the sense of security
areas.scorpio: power, shared resources, secrets and the way out of crises
areas.sagittarius: belief, travel, higher education and law

jupiter.aries: Jupiter in Aries: courage, initiative and new beginnings expand. Favourable for enterprise and leadership, risky for hasty decisions and for conflicts flaring up.
jupiter.taurus: Jupiter in Taurus: steady growth, material well-being and a return to nature. A good backdrop for property, farming and saving, with a pull toward overconsumption.
jupiter.gemini: Jupiter in Gemini: information, learning, media and trade expand. There are many ideas and voices; the difficulty is choosing among an abundance of information.
jupiter.cancer: Jupiter in Cancer: the sense of family, home and homeland strengthens. Housing, care and mutual support come forward, and so does the search for emotional comfort.
jupiter.leo: Jupiter in Leo: creativity, entertainment, leadership and individual expression expand. Charismatic figures come forward; pride and showing off can go too far.
jupiter.virgo: Jupiter in Virgo: the fields of work, health and service grow. Good for improving methods and order, with the risk of getting stuck in details and losing the big picture.
jupiter.libra: Jupiter in Libra: partnership, diplomacy and justice come forward. Favourable for agreements and legal reform; indecision and too many compromises are possible.
jupiter.scorpio: Jupiter in Scorpio: deep change, shared finance, debt and the opening of hidden matters. There is a chance of renewal after a crisis, and power games grow stronger.
jupiter.sagittarius: Jupiter in Sagittarius is at home: belief, travel, higher education and law expand. Optimism is high and can turn into overconfidence.
jupiter.capricorn: Jupiter in Capricorn: expansion goes through institutions and the state, planned and gradual. Good for steady work, but optimism is more limited than Jupiter's natural strength.
jupiter.aquarius: Jupiter in Aquarius: technology, collective projects and social innovation grow. Ideas of equality and participation are on the agenda; abstract ideals need real steps behind them.
jupiter.pisces: Jupiter in Pisces is at home: compassion, spirituality, art and charity grow stronger. Dreams and faith grow, and so does the risk of escapism and illusion.

saturn.aries: Saturn in Aries: initiative and leadership are tested by discipline. Society learns to start new things and to take responsibility; impatience is held back.
saturn.taurus: Saturn in Taurus: tightening and a re-evaluation around money, property and resources. Thrift and a firm foundation come forward; material shocks make people rethink values.
saturn.gemini: Saturn in Gemini: information, education and communication call for rules and responsibility. Measures against false information and reforms in education are possible.
saturn.cancer: Saturn in Cancer: a serious test of family, housing and security. Rebuilding in the home and provision sectors, and facing emotional coldness.
saturn.leo: Saturn in Leo: severity around leadership, authority and creativity. Leaders' responsibility is checked; measure is required in entertainment and self-display.
saturn.virgo: Saturn in Virgo: the labour market, health services and efficiency are rebuilt. Order and skill are valued; the risk is excessive control and exhaustion.
saturn.libra: Saturn in Libra: relationships, law and the justice system are tested. Contracts, diplomacy and partnership bring serious commitments.
saturn.scorpio: Saturn in Scorpio: shared finance, debt and power structures are examined. What was hidden can come out; deep rebuilding is hard but gives a solid result.
saturn.sagittarius: Saturn in Sagittarius: belief systems, higher education and laws are tested. A worldview must be grounded in responsibility; border and travel rules can tighten.
saturn.capricorn: Saturn in Capricorn is at home: the state, authority and institutions grow stronger and rules tighten. Long-term plans and discipline come forward; so does the risk of authoritarianism.
saturn.aquarius: Saturn in Aquarius is at home: technology, networks and the rules of society are rebuilt. Collective responsibility and systematic innovation are the theme.
saturn.pisces: Saturn in Pisces: ideals, spirituality and collective dreams are tested against reality. Illusions collapse and care and compassion call for serious structure.

uranus.aries: Uranus in Aries: sudden beginnings, personal freedom and a wave of initiative. Old conflicts can flare in a new form; society changes with courage.
uranus.taurus: Uranus in Taurus: the system of money, land, food and values is shaken. New financial tools and sudden price moves arrive, with new approaches to nature and resources.
uranus.gemini: Uranus in Gemini: fast change in information, media and communication. New technologies and forms of exchanging ideas, and also information confusion.
uranus.cancer: Uranus in Cancer: the idea of family, home and homeland is rethought. Sudden changes in settlement, migration and provision are possible.
uranus.leo: Uranus in Leo: sudden change in self-expression, creativity and figures of authority. Leaders change and the idea of recognition is renewed.
uranus.virgo: Uranus in Virgo: technical innovation in work, health and daily life. The job market and the health system are rebuilt.
uranus.libra: Uranus in Libra: new forms in relationships, marriage and social rules. The idea of law and partnership shifts; separations and new unions multiply.
uranus.scorpio: Uranus in Scorpio: power, shared finance and the sudden surfacing of what was hidden. Deep, sometimes shattering transformations and the opening of taboo subjects.
uranus.sagittarius: Uranus in Sagittarius: belief, travel and a widening worldview. Laws and borders are renegotiated; a leap in education and religious views.
uranus.capricorn: Uranus in Capricorn: authority, institutions and traditional structures crack. A root-and-branch rebuild of state administration and the economic system.
uranus.aquarius: Uranus in Aquarius is at home: a leap in technology, society and collective freedom. Innovation arrives like a natural flow and social movements strengthen.
uranus.pisces: Uranus in Pisces: spirituality, imagination and the dissolving of boundaries. New forms of belief, the growth of digital and virtual worlds, and a waking up from illusions.

neptune.aries: Neptune in Aries: new ideals and dreams are born. Society reaches for personal courage and spiritual beginnings, while harsh heroic images can mislead.
neptune.taurus: Neptune in Taurus: ideals and illusions about money, land and values. Financial illusions and a spiritual bond with nature grow together.
neptune.gemini: Neptune in Gemini: information and communication turn hazy. Media, disinformation and poetic forms of thought are the theme.
neptune.cancer: Neptune in Cancer: family, homeland and belonging are idealised. Dreams about home and homeland, and also emotional dependence and loss.
neptune.leo: Neptune in Leo: fame, entertainment and creativity are idealised. Cinema, music and the culture of recognition grow; the image of the leader can become an illusion.
neptune.virgo: Neptune in Virgo: uncertainty in work, health and service. Illusion and confusion in health care, food and the workplace, along with themes of healing and care.
neptune.libra: Neptune in Libra: relationships and justice are idealised. Dreams of love and partnership, and uncertainty in the legal system.
neptune.scorpio: Neptune in Scorpio: the hidden, secrets and collective intuition deepen. Illusion around power and shared resources, and a theme of spiritual transformation.
neptune.sagittarius: Neptune in Sagittarius: religious and philosophical searching widens. Great ideals and sects, the search for truth and spiritual ascent are the theme together.
neptune.capricorn: Neptune in Capricorn: faith in institutions and authority dissolves and a new order is sought. Illusion in governments and economic systems, and a theme of spiritual responsibility.
neptune.aquarius: Neptune in Aquarius: collective dreams about technology and society. Virtual worlds, networks and utopian ideas strengthen, with the risk of illusion behind them.
neptune.pisces: Neptune in Pisces is at home: spirituality, compassion and imagination are at their strongest. Art and healing flourish, and so does escape from the truth.

pluto.aries: Pluto in Aries: a new era of collective will, independence and struggle for power. War and revolution, and also the individual's rebirth through courage.
pluto.taurus: Pluto in Taurus: deep transformation around money, land and resources. Financial systems, natural wealth and values are rebuilt.
pluto.gemini: Pluto in Gemini: root change in information, media and communication. Ways of thinking and teaching are transformed, and there is a struggle for power over information.
pluto.cancer: Pluto in Cancer: the idea of family, homeland and security is deeply transformed. Shocks around the state, territory and roots, and a renewal of collective memory.
pluto.leo: Pluto in Leo: a transformation of power in leadership, identity and creativity. Deep change around the worship of personalities and freedom of self-expression.
pluto.virgo: Pluto in Virgo: a deep rebuilding of work, health and daily life. Transformation in health care, the labour market and ecological questions.
pluto.libra: Pluto in Libra: relationships, law and the social contract are deeply transformed. The idea of justice and partnership is rebuilt.
pluto.scorpio: Pluto in Scorpio is at home: power, secrets and collective trauma go through their most intense deepening. Crisis and renewal, the opening of what was hidden, deep psychological change.
pluto.sagittarius: Pluto in Sagittarius: belief systems, religions and laws are transformed at the root. Worldviews and borders are rebuilt and ideological struggles strengthen.
pluto.capricorn: Pluto in Capricorn: the state, authority and economic institutions are deeply transformed. Old structures fall and new ones are built, with a struggle over power and money.
pluto.aquarius: Pluto in Aquarius: deep change in technology, society and collective power. Digital systems, networks and social structures are rebuilt, with a struggle between control and freedom.
pluto.pisces: Pluto in Pisces: collective belief, spirituality and imagination are deeply transformed. Spiritual values are renewed, illusions collapse and collective healing is the theme.

northNode.aries: North Node in Aries: society moves toward independence, courage and personal initiative; the South Node in Libra points away from excessive compromise and dependence.
northNode.taurus: North Node in Taurus: a move toward stability, values and natural resources; the South Node in Scorpio points away from crisis and shared dependence.
northNode.gemini: North Node in Gemini: a move toward learning, communication and openness to information; the South Node in Sagittarius points away from dogma.
northNode.cancer: North Node in Cancer: a move toward family, care and emotional security; the South Node in Capricorn points away from harsh authority and coldness.
northNode.leo: North Node in Leo: a move toward creativity, the heart and individual expression; the South Node in Aquarius points away from collective anonymity.
northNode.virgo: North Node in Virgo: a move toward service, health and practical improvement; the South Node in Pisces points away from escape and illusion.
northNode.libra: North Node in Libra: a move toward partnership, justice and agreement; the South Node in Aries points away from lone struggle and anger.
northNode.scorpio: North Node in Scorpio: a move toward deep transformation, shared resources and facing the truth; the South Node in Taurus points away from too much attachment to material comfort.
northNode.sagittarius: North Node in Sagittarius: a move toward belief, a wider worldview and the search for truth; the South Node in Gemini points away from superficial information.
northNode.capricorn: North Node in Capricorn: a move toward responsibility, structure and long-term building; the South Node in Cancer points away from excessive emotional dependence.
northNode.aquarius: North Node in Aquarius: a move toward the collective, technology and equality; the South Node in Leo points away from personal fame and ego.
northNode.pisces: North Node in Pisces: a move toward compassion, spirituality and surrender; the South Node in Virgo points away from excessive control and criticism.

pairs.jupiter_saturn: Jupiter and Saturn: expansion meets limit, hope meets reality. They join about every 20 years and change the tone of the economic and social cycle.
pairs.jupiter_uranus: Jupiter and Uranus: a wave of innovation, technological leaps and freedom. Unexpected opportunities and initiatives, and the risk of overreaching.
pairs.jupiter_neptune: Jupiter and Neptune: a wave of ideals, faith and spirituality. Compassion and great dreams, and the risk of illusion and exaggeration.
pairs.jupiter_pluto: Jupiter and Pluto: great expansion in power, resources and influence. Deep economic and political transformations, with the risk of control and excess power.
pairs.saturn_uranus: Saturn and Uranus: the old order meets the new. Reforms and system change, and tension between rule and freedom.
pairs.saturn_neptune: Saturn and Neptune: the dream meets reality. Ideals gain structure or collapse, and the collective mood is rebuilt. They join about every 36 years.
pairs.saturn_pluto: Saturn and Pluto: a deep rebuilding of the structures of power and control. Hard, long-lasting change in authority, the economy and security. They join about every 33 to 38 years.
pairs.uranus_neptune: Uranus and Neptune: the link between technology and spirituality, between innovation and ideal. Long cultural change at the level of a generation.
pairs.uranus_pluto: Uranus and Pluto: revolutionary, fast and deep change. A time of radical social renewal and collective movement against authority.
pairs.neptune_pluto: Neptune and Pluto: the slowest cycle, joining about every 492 years. A centuries-long transformation of collective consciousness, belief and spiritual values.

kinds.conjunction: Conjunction: the energies of two planets join and a new cycle begins. The theme is very strong and points in a single direction.
kinds.sextile: Sextile: the two energies support each other. There is a favourable opening, but it takes initiative to turn it into fact.
kinds.square: Square: tension and friction between two energies. It forces decisions and change and creates crisis, but it also pushes growth.
kinds.trine: Trine: the two energies flow easily. The theme moves forward without effort, though the ease should not turn into passivity.
kinds.opposition: Opposition: two energies face each other. Polarisation and a search for balance; the two sides have to be brought together.

eclipse.solar: A solar eclipse marks the start of a new chapter. Over the next six months change and a new direction open in that theme.
eclipse.lunar: A lunar eclipse marks the culmination and completion of a theme. What was hidden comes out and what is no longer needed is let go.
eclipse.total: A total eclipse has the strongest effect.
eclipse.annular: An annular eclipse works gradually and indirectly.
eclipse.partial: A partial eclipse is of medium strength.
eclipse.penumbral: A penumbral lunar eclipse is the weakest and is usually counted as slight in astrology.
eclipse.hybrid: A hybrid eclipse is counted among the strongest of the year.

retro.jupiter: Jupiter retrograde: themes of expansion are reconsidered. Plans are checked and the direction of faith and growth is thought over from within.
retro.saturn: Saturn retrograde: rules and responsibility are checked again. The weak places of institutions come out and unfinished work is returned to.
retro.uranus: Uranus retrograde: sudden change turns inward. The results of innovation are weighed, revolt cools and ideas ripen.
retro.neptune: Neptune retrograde: illusions fade and the reality of ideals is tested. Spiritual themes deepen from within.
retro.pluto: Pluto retrograde: the inner stage of deep transformation. Hidden power structures and collective trauma are looked at again.

1.name: Self and initiative
1.text: Being yourself, taking the first step and opening your own way turn up again and again in your life. Independence, courage and competition are a main line, not an accident; the lesson is patience and taking others into account.

2.name: Values and resources
2.text: Money, possessions, the body and the sense of self-worth repeat in your chart. Building a firm base, turning talent into income and knowing what you really value are among the main tasks of your life.

3.name: Communication and learning
3.text: Words, information, learning and the close circle (siblings, neighbours, daily contacts) repeat. Getting an idea across, writing, speaking and being curious are your main tools.

4.name: Home, family and roots
4.text: Home, family, roots and emotional security show up many times in the chart. Building a place where you feel at ease and understanding your past and your family are a main line of your life.

5.name: Creativity and self-expression
5.text: Creativity, joy, play, children and showing yourself repeat. Expressing what comes from the heart and being seen is a vital need for you; the lesson is to shine with the heart rather than with pride.

6.name: Work, service and health
6.text: Daily work, habits, health and being useful come forward in the chart. Order, skill and improvement are your strength; the lesson is to ease the pressure of perfectionism.

7.name: Relationships and partnership
7.text: Partnership, contracts, fairness and the theme of 'me and the other' repeat. Much of your life takes shape in meeting others; the lesson is to find balance without losing yourself.

8.name: Deep transformation and shared resources
8.text: Power, the hidden, crises, shared money and deep bonds repeat. Your life goes through renewals that feel like dying and being reborn; the lesson is to let go of control and trust change.

9.name: Meaning, belief and far horizons
9.text: Worldview, belief, higher learning, travel and the meaning of life repeat in the chart. Seeing the big picture, learning and teaching is your way; the lesson is not to turn belief into dogma.

10.name: Career, purpose and standing
10.text: Career, public standing, responsibility and a long-term goal show up many times. Building something and being recognised is a main line of your life; the lesson is not to measure success only by results.

11.name: Friends, community and the future
11.text: Friendship, groups, ideals, innovation and a view of the future repeat. Being part of something bigger with others gives you strength; the lesson is to belong to the group without losing your individuality.

12.name: Inner world and spirituality
12.text: The inner world, solitude, spirituality, compassion and the unseen repeat in the chart. Intuition and empathy are strong; the lesson is to help others while keeping your boundaries and not losing yourself.

conjunction.do: Put the energy into one concrete thing: sport, a task you have not started, a step that needs courage.
conjunction.avoid: Hasty decisions, arguments, fast driving and speaking in anger.

hard.do: Release the tension physically and keep a conflict for a calmer moment.
hard.avoid: Saying things in the heat of the moment, risky physical work and now-or-never decisions.

soft.do: Start the task you have put off for long; initiative comes easily.
soft.avoid: Scattering the energy over small things.

conjunction.do: Say yes to new openings: study, travel, a big project, new people.
conjunction.avoid: Promising, spending and taking on too much at once.

hard.do: Break the big plan into small steps and check the numbers twice.
hard.avoid: Inflated optimism, taking on debt and overrating your strength.

soft.do: Ask for help, apply, present yourself: doors open easily.
soft.avoid: Staying passive out of comfort and letting the chance go.

conjunction.do: Accept responsibility, make a long-term plan, choose what really matters.
conjunction.avoid: Running from difficulty, looking for shortcuts and overloading yourself.

hard.do: Be patient: split the problem into parts, work with discipline and steadily; get help if needed.
hard.avoid: Trying to carry everything alone, giving in to despair and quitting in haste.

soft.do: Build a firm base: a good time for contracts, rules, habits and long-term commitments.
soft.avoid: Losing a chance through too much caution.

conjunction.do: Be open to the new, change what is worn out, keep a plan B.
conjunction.avoid: Tearing everything down at once and sudden decisions without thought.

hard.do: Stay flexible: be ready for unexpected change and keep reserves (money, time).
hard.avoid: Burning bridges for the sake of rebellion and risky sudden moves.

soft.do: A good time to try a new method, technology, course or setting.
soft.avoid: Leaving what works for an exciting idea.

conjunction.do: Give time to intuition, creativity and spirituality; dream, but write it down.
conjunction.avoid: Signing important papers unchecked, being deceived and escape habits (alcohol, too much screen time).

hard.do: Check the facts, keep your boundaries, save the decision for a clear day.
hard.avoid: Believing someone without checking, vague promises and sacrificing yourself.

soft.do: A fine period for art, healing, charity and meditation.
soft.avoid: Letting everything drift and forgetting practical matters.

conjunction.do: Be ready for deep change: let go of what does not work, rebuild your strength.
conjunction.avoid: Holding on to control by force and entering power struggles.

hard.do: Face the hidden problem, get the support of a therapist or expert, clear up debt and power issues.
hard.avoid: Manipulation, stubbornness and an all-or-nothing stance.

soft.do: Good for deep renewal, investment, psychological work and root reform.
soft.avoid: Putting off a chance for big change out of fear.
